0obbv2h.text: The new shell gives way a bit when you sit on it. I'd forgotten that. It's been a while.

129i37z.text: Sit for a minute before you go. Who's turning your post while you're out?

0bxpygq.raw: 'Tack. Good. Counting is mostly a seated task. Make yourself comfortable.'
0bxpygq.text: Tack. Good. Counting is mostly a seated task. Make yourself comfortable.

03ehwgc.text: Perch on the edge with your legs dangling. That's how I did it. You kind of lean into it.

0acgu1j.raw: 'Take your time. I\'m right here. I\'ve spent forty years perfecting the art of sitting still.'
0acgu1j.text: Take your time. I'm right here. I've spent forty years perfecting the art of sitting still.

1igtm9d.text: Beneath Ouro's feet, the shell curves away, layer upon layer, descending to the sand.

186j1zx.raw: 'Here, the ridge is worn into a long, smooth dip, wide enough for a road.'
186j1zx.text: Here, the ridge is worn into a long, smooth dip, wide enough for a road.

0u4dnk3.raw: 'Something massive has leaned against it, repeatedly, over time.'
0u4dnk3.text: Something massive has leaned against it, repeatedly, over time.

1j80myc.raw: 'An old lip of the shell, left behind when it outgrew it one spring long past.'
1j80myc.text: An old lip of the shell, left behind when it outgrew it one spring long past.

0yswzij.raw: 'Tucked into a growth line in the lee of the third ridge lie two whelk horns.'
0yswzij.text: Tucked into a growth line in the lee of the third ridge lie two whelk horns.

0i5q5eu.raw: 'Here, sit. It\'s the best spot to see what you emerged from.'
0i5q5eu.text: Here, sit. It's the best spot to see what you emerged from.

18jkxua.raw: 'It is a shell. It rests on the sand. It is as large as a hill.'
18jkxua.text: It is a shell. It rests on the sand. It is as large as a hill.

0atm2qw.raw: 'Sit and gaze for a moment. It feels even larger from the inside.'
0atm2qw.text: Sit and gaze for a moment. It feels even larger from the inside.

0fn81qv.text: Descend the ridges to the sand.

05xypq7.raw: 'Further north along the shoreline, the sand dips into a hollow shaped like a shell. It sits empty.'
05xypq7.text: Further north along the shoreline, the sand dips into a hollow shaped like a shell. It sits empty.

15tzmqc.raw: 'Continuing north, you find another shell, paler and more weathered, half-buried in the sand.'
15tzmqc.text: Continuing north, you find another shell, paler and more weathered, half-buried in the sand.

1mdeg4z.raw: 'Still watching? Excellent. Take a seat and observe. It feels much larger from the inside.'
1mdeg4z.text: Still watching? Excellent. Take a seat and observe. It feels much larger from the inside.

1472muj.raw: 'Choose any shell, and join me inside it. The tide is dropping fast.'
1472muj.text: Choose any shell, and join me inside it. The tide is dropping fast.

0jkpkb4.raw: 'Come sit in one of these with me. Hurry, the tide is going out.'
0jkpkb4.text: Come sit in one of these with me. Hurry, the tide is going out.

0ry4ghy.raw: 'Do as you please. Then, take a seat by the entrance so I can keep an eye on you.'
0ry4ghy.text: Do as you please. Then, take a seat by the entrance so I can keep an eye on you.

0lqxtcu.raw: 'I always tap my foot in here. I can\'t help it.'
0lqxtcu.text: I always tap my foot in here. I can't help it.

12ft2xe.raw: 'Stay seated for a moment. Watch how the tide returns.'
12ft2xe.text: Stay seated for a moment. Watch how the tide returns.

0r06xce.raw: 'Can you spot the bell from down here? It\'s over there, on the post near the seaweed.'
0r06xce.text: Can you spot the bell from down here? It's over there, on the post near the seaweed.

0dt5j1w.raw: '(Ring the tide bell to turn the tide. At high tide, the low sand is submerged.)'
0dt5j1w.text: (Ring the tide bell to turn the tide. At high tide, the low sand is submerged.)

07u3geu.text: (At low tide the sand is exposed, and stars fall in a line.)

0hdye08.text: (At low water, a shell with nothing moving in it is gone when the shadow passes.)

07dhzid.raw: 'As for me, I\'m heading to sit by whatever fire they have. Head west, following the seaweed.'
07dhzid.text: As for me, I'm heading to sit by whatever fire they have. Head west, following the seaweed.

1ejn43c.raw: 'Travel west along the Wrack to reach the Sand Dollar.'
1ejn43c.text: Travel west along the Wrack to reach the Sand Dollar.

0qlj26o.raw: '(The Margin hole remains open. You can return at any time via the Outer Whorl.)'

0kaejux.raw: 'Cinch is at the fire in the Sand Dollar.'
0kaejux.text: Cinch is at the fire in the Sand Dollar.

0uznff0.text: I switch shells every low tide, that's my rule. Yesterday I was in a whelk. Terribly drafty.

0xt5pm9.text: Fine. This one's taken. There are plenty more on the beach.

0edr3cd.raw: 'Grains go to the Sifter. You\'re going into the sand.'
0edr3cd.text: Grains go to the Sifter. You're going into the sand.

1tl02jg.raw: 'Ugh. The Sifter will hear about this. And judge it.'
1tl02jg.text: Ugh. The Sifter will hear about this. And judge it.

1tf13d6.text: Everything floats in. Some of it floats back out. I want to see where it goes.

0ml3k7m.text: I'm drifting back. Don't come after me, or you'll drown.

0psc3xo.raw: 'Tucked in a tangle of black weed, dry within, a notion.'
0psc3xo.text: Tucked in a tangle of black weed, dry within, a notion.

19sfxr6.text: A plate-sized oyster sits in the pool. Ouro cracks it open, revealing the nacre.

1emywcv.raw: 'A hollow log holds a triton horn within.'
1emywcv.text: A hollow log holds a triton horn within.

1xeae0m.raw: 'The Sand Dollar is to the west. At low water, get in something. Underneath, scratched: and WIGGLE'
1xeae0m.text: The Sand Dollar is to the west. At low water, get in something. Underneath, scratched: and WIGGLE

1xj151w.text: The tide is low, so we're inside. Hi! No stopping now.

0ky4z4e.raw: 'Keep going, Mim. That\'s the spirit. Big rocks. Perfect.'
0ky4z4e.text: Keep going, Mim. That's the spirit. Big rocks. Perfect.

1jssr7m.raw: 'Which whorl do you want to leave?'
1jssr7m.text: Which whorl do you want to leave?

0zu9odg.text: Dear inside. Low water, I'm in the log. Logs used to be trees. Dear trees, what's it like up there?

14qaetz.text: Dear inside. Another one washed ashore today, hidden beneath a crab. The crab says hello.

1waundn.text: Dear whoever finds these. I discover them all along the wrack line. Apologies for the sand inside.

1g1jwg9.raw: 'Dear sea. Please take this one under the large shell. Shell, bell, well.'
1g1jwg9.text: Dear sea. Please take this one under the large shell. Shell, bell, well.

0ld8heu.text: Dear well, are you down there?

1qr0jkg.raw: 'Dear whoever is inside. Somebody read one!! Somebody actually read one of them!!'
1qr0jkg.text: Dear whoever is inside. Somebody read one!! Somebody actually read one of them!!

0magzv5.raw: 'Dear Mum. The good stone isn\'t under my bed anymore. I gave it away. Don\'t look for it.'
0magzv5.text: Dear Mum. The good stone isn't under my bed anymore. I gave it away. Don't look for it.

0lb42hh.raw: 'Dear whoever writes these. It\'s nobody here. We checked. Your letters are so huge.'
0lb42hh.text: Dear whoever writes these. It's nobody here. We checked. Your letters are so huge.

1kleocm.raw: 'Dear sea. Take them back. You keep sending them. Sending is for parties. Dear party, I can\'t come.'
1kleocm.text: Dear sea. Take them back. You keep sending them. Sending is for parties. Dear party, I can't come.

06hp028.raw: 'The water\'s low. I\'m in my barrow, rocking it. Don\'t watch me.'
06hp028.text: The water's low. I'm in my barrow, rocking it. Don't watch me.

1p7npwr.raw: 'I rake the weed into neat lines. The sea does it anyway, just worse lines.'
1p7npwr.text: I rake the weed into neat lines. The sea does it anyway, just worse lines.

0ksqrzd.raw: 'See the glints in the weed? Grains. You can spot them at night. Leave them alone.'
0ksqrzd.text: See the glints in the weed? Grains. You can spot them at night. Leave them alone.

1khwvjs.raw: 'One house. Two lows a day. And a grand, unbroken total of zero grains lost!'
1khwvjs.text: One house. Two lows a day. And a grand, unbroken total of zero grains lost!

0tpq1ac.raw: 'One whelk, one fire, one sieve. A sack of sand, a pinch of tea, a thimble of quiet.'
0tpq1ac.text: One whelk, one fire, one sieve. A sack of sand, a pinch of tea, a thimble of quiet.

1q44rdm.raw: 'Children have scratched their heights into the test wall, along with their names.'
1q44rdm.text: Children have scratched their heights into the test wall, along with their names.

0j21iyy.raw: 'The lowest mark is older than the rest and very small.'
0j21iyy.text: The lowest mark is older than the rest and very small.

1n40bk8.raw: 'A sack of cowries, tied at the neck. A shell tag on the string reads STRANDMONGER.'
1n40bk8.text: A sack of cowries, tied at the neck. A shell tag on the string reads STRANDMONGER.

0l9m9b4.raw: 'A driftwood fire in a ring of stones. It smells of salt.'
0l9m9b4.text: A driftwood fire in a ring of stones. It smells of salt.

0bk5vm9.raw: 'Under the steps cut into the test, in a dry hollow, a whelk horn and some cowries.'
0bk5vm9.text: Under the steps cut into the test, in a dry hollow, a whelk horn and some cowries.

13m3lfn.raw: 'The Strandmonger maintains a shop counter in the east petal.'
13m3lfn.text: The Strandmonger maintains a shop counter in the east petal.

0pg29up.raw: 'There are five doves in the middle of town. Don\'t go breaking the sand dollar to get at them.'
0pg29up.text: There are five doves in the middle of town. Don't go breaking the sand dollar to get at them.

0o1mb84.raw: 'Tide\'s out! I\'m shaking out my sieve. Apologies if sand gets in your shoes.'
0o1mb84.text: Tide's out! I'm shaking out my sieve. Apologies if sand gets in your shoes.

1nsaiyn.raw: 'We came off the old shell five grandmothers back. We walked the entire distance.'
1nsaiyn.text: We came off the old shell five grandmothers back. We walked the entire distance.

11qlnny.text: My feet still ache from it.

1c8abqe.raw: 'Tide\'s out. Sit, then kick. Kick, kick. I\'ve been doing this for seventy years.'
1c8abqe.text: Tide's out. Sit, then kick. Kick, kick. I've been doing this for seventy years.

1yifv0u.raw: 'My home is a whelk shell! I sweep it clean at every low tide so it knows I live there. It knows.'
1yifv0u.text: My home is a whelk shell! I sweep it clean at every low tide so it knows I live there. It knows.

1e6vlo1.text: Tide's out. Sweeping, sweeping, sweeping. Can't chat right now.

0japq6i.text: Your trader buys our cowrie shells by the sack. We simply sweep them off the seaweed.

1r0oefi.raw: 'It\'s the easiest money you\'ll ever make.'
1r0oefi.text: It's the easiest money you'll ever make.

01kvaxi.text: Tide's out. The Gleaner is out on the flats. Hear that sound? That's what it is.

0hrvbd8.raw: 'The stars descend with every low tide. You eventually get used to the noise. Well, somewhat.'
0hrvbd8.text: The stars descend with every low tide. You eventually get used to the noise. Well, somewhat.

0x93uvf.text: Tide's out. I'm flipping the fish. Don't tell me if it's burning.

0ndia9o.raw: 'Don\'t sit still in a hollow shell during low water. Obviously. Even the babies know that.'
0ndia9o.text: Don't sit still in a hollow shell during low water. Obviously. Even the babies know that.

0bh91po.text: Tide's out. I'm hopping. Hopping is the best one.

0nwvclm.text: Each line functions as a combat move, and she must progress through them in order.)

0l7r5d8.text: There you are. What a look on your face. Pure surprise. I'd pay two cowries just to see it again.

1p3hzt4.raw: 'I make this trek twice a year for cowries. They\'re cheap off the wrack. Sand cheap.'
1p3hzt4.text: I make this trek twice a year for cowries. They're cheap off the wrack. Sand cheap.

1pc3gt7.raw: 'Forty cowries a sack out here. Fifty if you take it inside.'
1pc3gt7.text: Forty cowries a sack out here. Fifty if you take it inside.

0gp7o1e.raw: 'Don\'t tell your gran, or she\'ll demand her cut.'
0gp7o1e.text: Don't tell your gran, or she'll demand her cut.

0bkbtzh.raw: 'Speaking of your gran. She sent a parcel. Paid six cowries for postage in advance.'
0bkbtzh.text: Speaking of your gran. She sent a parcel. Paid six cowries for postage in advance.

07vb2gj.text: Your gran said, "Tell my little turnip to take her." She said it to *them*, mind. Not to me.

02i8lqm.raw: 'I delivered the message for free. The carrying of *her*, however, I charged for. By the pound.'
02i8lqm.text: I delivered the message for free. The carrying of *her*, however, I charged for. By the pound.

097vuby.raw: 'I\'m staying a while. Register pages cost a cowrie each out here. It\'s a rip-off.'
097vuby.text: I'm staying a while. Register pages cost a cowrie each out here. It's a rip-off.

1kob6lq.raw: 'And I\'m the one doing the ripping.'
1kob6lq.text: And I'm the one doing the ripping.

187d9wy.raw: 'And there\'s a letter, from your friend at the post. One cowrie in postage due. I covered it.'
187d9wy.text: And there's a letter, from your friend at the post. One cowrie in postage due. I covered it.

1m4a9i8.text: Day 1. Rotated 1 time. Heavy. You owe 1 chair. Tack.

0yqphkc.raw: 'Grains, now. The Sifter keeps those. On this beach, a single grain is worth more than a pearl.'
0yqphkc.text: Grains, now. The Sifter keeps those. On this beach, a single grain is worth more than a pearl.

1ku1xtq.text: Not to me. I'd give you two cowries for one. Plus a button.

12ajxjx.raw: 'The Sifter stands in the town center, surrounded by doves.'
12ajxjx.text: The Sifter stands in the town center, surrounded by doves.

0550lgq.text: Strand species: one cowrie per page. Your grandmother's slate. I verified it extends this far.

1q17u5x.text: Remember? The walk out here is free. The road costs shoes. I told you that for nothing.

0badf1n.text: You found my path. The toll is one cowrie per trip. I just put it up.

1b3m2oz.raw: 'Which I\'ll waive, once. Worth more to you than a cowrie and less to me. We both win. Me more.'
1b3m2oz.text: Which I'll waive, once. Worth more to you than a cowrie and less to me. We both win. Me more.

01fgq3s.raw: 'Keep it quiet from your grandmother. She\'d exploit it and never pay.'
01fgq3s.text: Keep it quiet from your grandmother. She'd exploit it and never pay.

1ig88eo.raw: 'She pulled that same trick on a bridge once.'
1ig88eo.text: She pulled that same trick on a bridge once.

16sl7pt.raw: 'And one more. A letter, one cowrie for postage. Your friend has tiny handwriting. A miser.'
16sl7pt.text: And one more. A letter, one cowrie for postage. Your friend has tiny handwriting. A miser.

0i9n7sp.text: Day 9. 9 turns. Lug says close in here. Fid says post 19 spans round. Knew already. Tack.

1po1xwu.raw: 'Letter. A cowrie. He\'s started numbering the pages now. It costs me nothing, and that annoys me.'
1po1xwu.text: Letter. A cowrie. He's started numbering the pages now. It costs me nothing, and that annoys me.

068hyjx.raw: 'Day 17. 17 turns. Hasp asked about hands 3 times. Purchase charged for 1 chair. Tack.'
068hyjx.text: Day 17. 17 turns. Hasp asked about hands 3 times. Purchase charged for 1 chair. Tack.

0dov0op.text: Yeah? The shop is right here in the petal. Midden is down under the floor. It stays dry, mostly.

1turuek.text: The Conjoiner is in the back. Your Volute shells join with ours just fine. It holds. Anything else?

19895d1.text: Nothing stands higher than that long one.

0iy4irm.text: They go pretty close to it.

0n4fcjv.raw: 'Everyone heads inside when the tide goes out.'
0n4fcjv.text: Everyone heads inside when the tide goes out.

1mo7wn7.text: Which version are you asking about?

1oepp1a.text: Catch thirty stars in a night, and you earn a notion.

1cwljza.text: Salt is defeated by two forces: the tide and the void.

15881w9.text: That accounts for every possible pinch of salt.

1iwhhld.text: A handful of losses weighs nothing. Come back with a fuller sack.

1j93wzv.raw: 'Four down. One up. A most proper and pleasing trade.'

0ru60qu.text: (Star grains raise the cap on Strand levels. With one grain, your whorls can reach Strand level 13.)

0rsxbxv.text: One more sackful, and then home for supper. A hearty, well-deserved meal.

1dad865.raw: 'Just one house. By my measure, none now.'
1dad865.text: Just one house. By my measure, none now.

0xuu7kg.text: I've lived there for thirty years,

1qvm5va.raw: 'yet losing it after two hours for just one grain is a dreadful bargain.'
1qvm5va.text: yet losing it after two hours for just one grain is a dreadful bargain.

03aoiuj.text: There's a sack full of sieves, a pound of tea, and a modest handful of spoons.

0fhn0qi.raw: 'Come sit with me. There\'s room by the fire until you find another house.'
0fhn0qi.text: Come sit with me. There's room by the fire until you find another house.

0dzk5f4.raw: 'Head back east along the Wrack to the base of the Volute.'
0dzk5f4.text: Head back east along the Wrack to the base of the Volute.

0y4z0tw.raw: 'Two lows! Just one house, finally restored to its proper, full count of one!'
0y4z0tw.text: Two lows! Just one house, finally restored to its proper, full count of one!

0gvg9bw.raw: 'Three grains of nacre, a sack of cowries, and a heap of thanks. That\'s a fair deal.'
0gvg9bw.text: Three grains of nacre, a sack of cowries, and a heap of thanks. That's a fair deal.

1o9l7n3.raw: 'One whelk, wide at the door and a span longer than I am. That\'s the size I need.'
1o9l7n3.text: One whelk, wide at the door and a span longer than I am. That's the size I need.

16j8q3q.raw: 'It has to hold steady for two consecutive lows. Two! I won\'t trust it if it\'s less.'
16j8q3q.text: It has to hold steady for two consecutive lows. Two! I won't trust it if it's less.

0858czn.raw: '(A whelk washes up on the outermost weed ring of the Wrack at high tide.)'
0858czn.text: (A whelk washes up on the outermost weed ring of the Wrack at high tide.)

11qx0zj.raw: 'In the shallow runnel, under less than an inch of cold water, lies a nautilus horn.'
11qx0zj.text: In the shallow runnel, under less than an inch of cold water, lies a nautilus horn.

0tpm7gy.raw: 'A razor hole, dug straight down. At the bottom, a notion.'
0tpm7gy.text: A razor hole, dug straight down. At the bottom, a notion.

16xzx6w.raw: 'A curl of sand, still twisting. Inside, some nacre.'
16xzx6w.text: A curl of sand, still twisting. Inside, some nacre.

0ki56rl.raw: '(At low water, you see only inside the rings of landed stars. Soft sand appears only in a ring.)'
0ki56rl.text: (At low water, you see only inside the rings of landed stars. Soft sand appears only in a ring.)

1c1dvbw.text: Try {#1}. The 47 footprints are the same. The tide hasn't changed.

1be2s29.text: 47 footprints from the big shell to here. Each 1 is the size of a pond. Walked round all of them.

059roxu.raw: '2nd battle out here, 1st real one. Brack\'s at Strand level 14. I checked twice.'
059roxu.text: 2nd battle out here, 1st real one. Brack's at Strand level 14. I checked twice.

1xtylec.raw: '1 of us is going home soaked. Not me.'
1xtylec.text: 1 of us is going home soaked. Not me.

1kwr806.raw: `${tackWinsLine()} Go ahead, count them. I'll be right here waiting.`
1kwr806.text: {#1} Go ahead, count them. I'll be right here waiting.

14a5rv2.raw: `${t.ouro} losses. ${t.tack} wins. Even here, it's a tie. fantastic.`
14a5rv2.text: {t.ouro} losses. {t.tack} wins. Even here, it's a tie. fantastic.

0i2wdmd.raw: 'Footprints keep going. 1 every 30 steps. I\'m counting the rest. Don\'t wait up.'
0i2wdmd.text: Footprints keep going. 1 every 30 steps. I'm counting the rest. Don't wait up.

17bjjl7.raw: 'I count the Cowrie\'s spots. They shift when I blink, so I force myself not to. Ow.'
17bjjl7.text: I count the Cowrie's spots. They shift when I blink, so I force myself not to. Ow.

1mtqi79.raw: 'I lost my count. I blinked. Starting over from the top.'
1mtqi79.text: I lost my count. I blinked. Starting over from the top.

033mlir.raw: 'I stand in the gray at high water. It\'s incredibly warm in there. Nobody believes me.'
033mlir.text: I stand in the gray at high water. It's incredibly warm in there. Nobody believes me.

1yajk02.raw: 'Back in the gray. It\'s warm in there, I swear it is.'
1yajk02.text: Back in the gray. It's warm in there, I swear it is.

1cz2zzc.raw: 'Resting in a depression worn smooth by feet atop the dome is a triton horn.'
1cz2zzc.text: Resting in a depression worn smooth by feet atop the dome is a triton horn.

1leabt1.raw: '(A SALT whorl worn in the lead walks you through the gray.)'
1leabt1.text: (A SALT whorl worn in the lead walks you through the gray.)

1qzjtvx.raw: 'Still around? Take a seat. I came down when the stamping began. I heard it over at the bar.'
1qzjtvx.text: Still around? Take a seat. I came down when the stamping began. I heard it over at the bar.

00g9otn.raw: 'From down here, they look brand new.'
00g9otn.text: From down here, they look brand new.

1t0fhzq.raw: 'I buff the sky. All of it. You\'re up next. You\'ve got smudges.'
1t0fhzq.text: I buff the sky. All of it. You're up next. You've got smudges.

1fl7kdc.raw: 'It\'s smudged. Let it be. Don\'t you dare try to wipe it off.'
1fl7kdc.text: It's smudged. Let it be. Don't you dare try to wipe it off.

1xyhp8p.raw: 'My pig is glazed. So is my purse. So is my other pig.'
1xyhp8p.text: My pig is glazed. So is my purse. So is my other pig.

1irkdzg.raw: 'The glaze cracks. Yeah, I knew that.'
1irkdzg.text: The glaze cracks. Yeah, I knew that.

07azq3p.raw: 'A tiny dark spot stands out against the blank, against nothing at all.'
07azq3p.text: A tiny dark spot stands out against the blank, against nothing at all.

1f7sfdm.raw: 'A pool of polish. Ouro leans over it. Nothing reflects back for three breaths. Then Ouro does.'
1f7sfdm.text: A pool of polish. Ouro leans over it. Nothing reflects back for three breaths. Then Ouro does.

1e8agbw.raw: 'Small handprints pressed into the polish while it was soft, hundreds of them,'
1e8agbw.text: Small handprints pressed into the polish while it was soft, hundreds of them,

1jubs6t.raw: 'The highest one sits just a bit higher than the others.'
1jubs6t.text: The highest one sits just a bit higher than the others.

1thpi8x.raw: 'A pile of cushions lies beneath the drill hole. Someone fluffs them after every drop.'
1thpi8x.text: A pile of cushions lies beneath the drill hole. Someone fluffs them after every drop.

1ecuqzi.raw: 'Gloss is the keeper of the mouth. The way down is past the blank, at the bottom of town.'
1ecuqzi.text: Gloss is the keeper of the mouth. The way down is past the blank, at the bottom of town.

0f3jgzq.raw: 'We polish the interior daily. You can see your feet in it. It\'s a bit late, but you can.'
0f3jgzq.text: We polish the interior daily. You can see your feet in it. It's a bit late, but you can.

0lu6sl1.raw: 'The water is low. Stamp! Come on, stamp.'
0lu6sl1.text: The water is low. Stamp! Come on, stamp.

1ioyg12.raw: 'Something touched the floor. So we stamped. And it vanished. That\'s all I know.'
1ioyg12.text: Something touched the floor. So we stamped. And it vanished. That's all I know.

0jt21h1.raw: 'Your reflection is three steps behind you. Mine\'s four. I\'m older, so.'
0jt21h1.text: Your reflection is three steps behind you. Mine's four. I'm older, so.

0pprk3n.raw: 'We\'re stamping. My reflection is stamping too, eventually.'
0pprk3n.text: We're stamping. My reflection is stamping too, eventually.

11jr2eg.raw: 'There\'s a draft coming from the mouth. I haven\'t felt one since I was three steps behind.'
11jr2eg.text: There's a draft coming from the mouth. I haven't felt one since I was three steps behind.

0zqmk7l.raw: 'The floor is crooked now. And I\'m four steps behind. Give me a year.'
0zqmk7l.text: The floor is crooked now. And I'm four steps behind. Give me a year.

1em2vnr.raw: 'The mouth has been shut since my grandmother\'s grandmother. We prefer it shut. Shut is good.'
1em2vnr.text: The mouth has been shut since my grandmother's grandmother. We prefer it shut. Shut is good.

17am5rk.raw: 'You stamp too, right? Everybody stamps at low tide.'
17am5rk.text: You stamp too, right? Everybody stamps at low tide.

0vqun1a.raw: 'Who cracked it open? You? Great. Now we have to stamp more.'
0vqun1a.text: Who cracked it open? You? Great. Now we have to stamp more.

1pg9ttc.raw: 'There are posts outside now. Gran says they\'re for us. She didn\'t say what for.'
1pg9ttc.text: There are posts outside now. Gran says they're for us. She didn't say what for.

18gxvnk.raw: 'At low water, we all stamp at once. It\'s the only dance we have. It\'s a good dance.'
18gxvnk.text: At low water, we all stamp at once. It's the only dance we have. It's a good dance.

0t72i3a.raw: 'High water, and everything has rolled back to the seaward wall. Leave it. I do.'
0t72i3a.text: High water, and everything has rolled back to the seaward wall. Leave it. I do.

00m7epn.raw: 'From now on, we stamp every low tide. Harder. Way harder.'
00m7epn.text: From now on, we stamp every low tide. Harder. Way harder.

14xgyc6.raw: 'You lot spend little cowries? Fine by us. They belong to no one.'
14xgyc6.text: You lot spend little cowries? Fine by us. They belong to no one.

07lqiu0.raw: 'Gloss lives at the mouth. Gloss repeats everything. We only say it once. Once is enough.'
07lqiu0.text: Gloss lives at the mouth. Gloss repeats everything. We only say it once. Once is enough.

0k9nciw.raw: 'High tide! Tilt or slide. I go with sliding.'
0k9nciw.text: High tide! Tilt or slide. I go with sliding.

0uwand8.raw: 'The spots in the sky complete a circle once a year, dear. That one is late. It always is.'
0uwand8.text: The spots in the sky complete a circle once a year, dear. That one is late. It always is.

05h9vfj.raw: 'I play Gloss\'s cards. Gloss plays nothing at all, and wins!! Most efficient.'
05h9vfj.text: I play Gloss's cards. Gloss plays nothing at all, and wins!! Most efficient.

0vlrd7j.raw: 'We observe the Strand rule. The bottom row is wet. Watch your edges so they don\'t get soggy.'
0vlrd7j.text: We observe the Strand rule. The bottom row is wet. Watch your edges so they don't get soggy.

0uja2rc.raw: 'That pale patch is the blank. It\'s where the Cowrie never finished. You can\'t walk there.'
0uja2rc.text: That pale patch is the blank. It's where the Cowrie never finished. You can't walk there.

0gm8j1o.raw: 'Mine can! It fell from the sky. It walks on nothing. It\'s so good at it.'
0gm8j1o.text: Mine can! It fell from the sky. It walks on nothing. It's so good at it.

1hlay8l.raw: 'Put one on, and you\'ll be able to walk in it. They\'re on the Cowrie\'s back. Go catch one!'
1hlay8l.text: Put one on, and you'll be able to walk in it. They're on the Cowrie's back. Go catch one!

0kgj6zl.raw: '(A VOID whorl worn in the lead guides you across the blank.)'
0kgj6zl.text: (A VOID whorl worn in the lead guides you across the blank.)

0jmugpc.raw: 'Past the fifth tooth, buried in the packed sand, lie a nautilus horn and a notion.'
0jmugpc.text: Past the fifth tooth, buried in the packed sand, lie a nautilus horn and a notion.

0dyit4j.raw: 'The slit. A line of light rises through it from outside.'
0dyit4j.text: The slit. A line of light rises through it from outside.

12qdcny.raw: 'Mouth agape, starlight crosses the Glaze Halls at low water. The door is in the Polish.'
12qdcny.text: Mouth agape, starlight crosses the Glaze Halls at low water. The door is in the Polish.

1lsfly2.text: The tooth closest to the light moves at your command. That's the simple one.

0ddker4.raw: 'Any other tooth will only move if the one toward the light is open,'
0ddker4.text: Any other tooth will only move if the one toward the light is open,

09q6abo.raw: 'while all those beyond it remain closed.'
09q6abo.text: while all those beyond it remain closed.

1kimsmw.raw: '(Open the first four teeth to open the mouth.)'
1kimsmw.text: (Open the first four teeth to open the mouth.)

1fayi9d.raw: 'I sit between the teeth. Only gap in town. I got here first.'
1fayi9d.text: I sit between the teeth. Only gap in town. I got here first.

11zxw0j.raw: 'The gap is yours. Watch out for the sand.'
11zxw0j.text: The gap is yours. Watch out for the sand.

1se3wn7.raw: 'I chase my own reflection down here! It\'s always three steps behind me. I\'ll catch it one day.'
1se3wn7.text: I chase my own reflection down here! It's always three steps behind me. I'll catch it one day.

1qqwpd8.raw: 'Whoa. It finally caught up. That\'s never happened before.'
1qqwpd8.text: Whoa. It finally caught up. That's never happened before.

1e8m6f7.raw: 'The halls are pitch-black at high tide. At low water, with the mouth open, starlight streams in.'
1e8m6f7.text: The halls are pitch-black at high tide. At low water, with the mouth open, starlight streams in.

0jnhs8z.raw: '(Your reflection follows your path, staying three steps behind you.)'
0jnhs8z.text: (Your reflection follows your path, staying three steps behind you.)

1l8srne.raw: '(A plate in the glaze opens its door when your reflection stands on it.)'
1l8srne.text: (A plate in the glaze opens its door when your reflection stands on it.)

1o5qma8.raw: `${d.word} marks are carved into it, stacked one above the other.`
1o5qma8.text: {d.word} marks are carved into it, stacked one above the other.

1n2kt1r.raw: 'You entered through the reverse doorway. Through the reverse doorway, you entered.'
1n2kt1r.text: You entered through the reverse doorway. Through the reverse doorway, you entered.

0y5vsso.raw: 'I remain at the threshold. The threshold remains with me.'
0y5vsso.text: I remain at the threshold. The threshold remains with me.

0uh0nps.raw: 'The floor preserves your steps with distinction. With distinction, your steps preserve the floor.'
0uh0nps.text: The floor preserves your steps with distinction. With distinction, your steps preserve the floor.

1unzz1n.raw: 'Traverse it there and back. Traverse it back and there.'
1unzz1n.text: Traverse it there and back. Traverse it back and there.

0ujbvyu.raw: '(The floor retains your final steps. A door opens when they read the same backward as forward.)'
0ujbvyu.text: (The floor retains your final steps. A door opens when they read the same backward as forward.)

03fk7eb.raw: '(Colliding with a pillar clears the floor. Each door requires as many steps as it has marks.)'
03fk7eb.text: (Colliding with a pillar clears the floor. Each door requires as many steps as it has marks.)

1vriri5.raw: 'The Cowrie is marked, alas! Alas, the Cowrie is marked!'
1vriri5.text: The Cowrie is marked, alas! Alas, the Cowrie is marked!

014lv3h.raw: 'At every low water, we stamp in unison. In unison, we stamp at every low water.'
014lv3h.text: At every low water, we stamp in unison. In unison, we stamp at every low water.

14wfm3h.raw: 'The light entered at the low water, shining brilliantly!'
14wfm3h.text: The light entered at the low water, shining brilliantly!

187i1st.raw: 'Brilliantly, at the low water, the light entered!'
187i1st.text: Brilliantly, at the low water, the light entered!

0sp9qyj.raw: 'Pace back and forth. There and back, pace it.'
0sp9qyj.text: Pace back and forth. There and back, pace it.

0zfojdp.raw: 'A single grain is the reward for a struggle. For a struggle, the reward is a single grain.'
0zfojdp.text: A single grain is the reward for a struggle. For a struggle, the reward is a single grain.

1m8p63b.raw: 'My four are slow, just like your face in the floor.'
1m8p63b.text: My four are slow, just like your face in the floor.

0i8cqlf.raw: 'Just like your face in the floor, my four are slow.'
0i8cqlf.text: Just like your face in the floor, my four are slow.

0yx261b.raw: 'You lost to the light. The light lost to you.'
0yx261b.text: You lost to the light. The light lost to you.

0ea0htt.raw: 'The grain is yours, a gift! A gift, the grain is yours!'
0ea0htt.text: The grain is yours, a gift! A gift, the grain is yours!

1abazys.raw: '(With two grains, your whorls can reach Strand level 18.)'
1abazys.text: (With two grains, your whorls can reach Strand level 18.)

04ye1c5.raw: 'The light came in at low water. At low water, the light came in.'
04ye1c5.text: The light came in at low water. At low water, the light came in.

102bapz.raw: 'It brushed against the floor. The floor brushed against it.'
102bapz.text: It brushed against the floor. The floor brushed against it.

0ulnxuh.raw: 'You let the light in. The light let you in.'
0ulnxuh.text: You let the light in. The light let you in.

0nmwgwl.raw: 'Sit down. I came down when the stamping started. I heard it from the bar.'
0nmwgwl.text: Sit down. I came down when the stamping started. I heard it from the bar.

03ph00j.raw: 'They look brand new from down here.'
03ph00j.text: They look brand new from down here.

1wl9js8.raw: 'Swim back across the Flats to the Sand Dollar at high water.'
1wl9js8.text: Swim back across the Flats to the Sand Dollar at high water.

0gqrcte.raw: 'Is that the driller? It looks like a button. A cheap one. I wouldn\'t sew it on a sack.'
0gqrcte.text: Is that the driller? It looks like a button. A cheap one. I wouldn't sew it on a sack.

0j0gk4c.raw: 'Here\'s three hundred cowries. Keep that thing away from my stock. And my shoes.'
0j0gk4c.text: Here's three hundred cowries. Keep that thing away from my stock. And my shoes.

0sjusg3.raw: 'Someone\'s drilling holes in my cowries! A hole cuts the price in half. Two holes, and I weep.'
0sjusg3.text: Someone's drilling holes in my cowries! A hole cuts the price in half. Two holes, and I weep.

0dakent.raw: 'Find the driller. I\'ll pay you exactly what a sack of whole ones is worth to me.'
0dakent.text: Find the driller. I'll pay you exactly what a sack of whole ones is worth to me.

0fu9dis.raw: 'That\'s less than you\'d ask for it. That\'s what trade is.'
0fu9dis.text: That's less than you'd ask for it. That's what trade is.

08efgwu.raw: 'Round holes are appearing in hard objects. The first one was found in a stone on the Flats.'
08efgwu.text: Round holes are appearing in hard objects. The first one was found in a stone on the Flats.

0cppcnm.raw: 'The Strandmonger stands at his counter in the Sand Dollar.'
0cppcnm.text: The Strandmonger stands at his counter in the Sand Dollar.

0lddaw9.raw: 'The dune shifts a foot with every tide, so I move my chair a foot. We\'re square.'
0lddaw9.text: The dune shifts a foot with every tide, so I move my chair a foot. We're square.

0m89d0l.raw: 'I\'ll slide my chair back a foot. Square again.'
0m89d0l.text: I'll slide my chair back a foot. Square again.

0r46u2a.raw: 'Tucked in the sand beneath the overhang, near the drop-off, lies a nautilus horn.'
0r46u2a.text: Tucked in the sand beneath the overhang, near the drop-off, lies a nautilus horn.

02b0gt4.raw: 'Don\'t try this route! Enter at the base and climb the inner face. Do it like a sensible person.'
02b0gt4.text: Don't try this route! Enter at the base and climb the inner face. Do it like a sensible person.

0lo2x2c.raw: 'We tally our rolls out here. That\'s the only use for the outside: keeping count.'
0lo2x2c.text: We tally our rolls out here. That's the only use for the outside: keeping count.

109qxyf.raw: 'A rack of small, shell-carved bells hangs nearby. Each one bears a unique chip along its rim.'
109qxyf.text: A rack of small, shell-carved bells hangs nearby. Each one bears a unique chip along its rim.

1djcld7.raw: 'Wall-mounted bunks stacked one above the other. Some are equipped with straps.'
1djcld7.text: Wall-mounted bunks stacked one above the other. Some are equipped with straps.

0e0aje6.raw: 'Bunks line this wall as well, with blankets neatly folded on both sides.'
0e0aje6.text: Bunks line this wall as well, with blankets neatly folded on both sides.

0gn410b.raw: 'Phew. Take a seat here for a moment. That was quite a climb.'
0gn410b.text: Phew. Take a seat here for a moment. That was quite a climb.

00dmigu.raw: 'The bottom step offers the best acoustics. You can hear every one of them scrambling up there.'
00dmigu.text: The bottom step offers the best acoustics. You can hear every one of them scrambling up there.

06mrc06.text: Ascend the Auger from the interior.

15yhe6m.raw: 'Step up. The water\'s at my knees, but it\'s moving.'
15yhe6m.text: Step up. The water's at my knees, but it's moving.

0soeeu5.raw: 'I felt every jolt from this step. Number seven. Solid step.'
0soeeu5.text: I felt every jolt from this step. Number seven. Solid step.

03yugbm.raw: 'The stairs will still be here if you take a seat. They always are.'
03yugbm.text: The stairs will still be here if you take a seat. They always are.

1f6n6pq.raw: 'Hear that? Sit on the lowest step and you can hear them all climbing.'
1f6n6pq.text: Hear that? Sit on the lowest step and you can hear them all climbing.

199ixml.raw: 'We climb all day. Then we sleep on the stairs at night, facing upward. Facing up matters.'
199ixml.text: We climb all day. Then we sleep on the stairs at night, facing upward. Facing up matters.

1fylgux.raw: 'We rolled over again. Up is still up, at least. Everything else shifted.'
1fylgux.text: We rolled over again. Up is still up, at least. Everything else shifted.

0m032dw.raw: 'We\'ll climb every low now. Even Gran. She\'s furious.'
0m032dw.text: We'll climb every low now. Even Gran. She's furious.

0k9tgv1.raw: 'When the tide rolls the Auger over, the floor becomes the wall. You learn to sleep on both.'
0k9tgv1.text: When the tide rolls the Auger over, the floor becomes the wall. You learn to sleep on both.

0l3g5du.raw: 'We rolled. My bunk is now the ceiling. Move over. I\'m sleeping in yours.'
0l3g5du.text: We rolled. My bunk is now the ceiling. Move over. I'm sleeping in yours.

0satei3.raw: 'No one has ever reached the point. It\'s too narrow for any grown person.'
0satei3.text: No one has ever reached the point. It's too narrow for any grown person.

0htod4e.raw: 'Low water, so climb. Climbing keeps the water down. That\'s what my dad said.'
0htod4e.text: Low water, so climb. Climbing keeps the water down. That's what my dad said.

1xcx10u.raw: 'It\'s never been down here before. There\'s the sea. Right there.'
1xcx10u.text: It's never been down here before. There's the sea. Right there.

1fogdtd.raw: 'My bowl is on the low side. Everyone\'s bowl is on the low side. Bowls roll.'
1fogdtd.text: My bowl is on the low side. Everyone's bowl is on the low side. Bowls roll.

0zgn7gh.raw: 'Everybody up the stairs. And down. And up. My legs!!'

14t2x21.raw: 'Speak with the round individual standing near the back wall.'

1bzn2dn.text: Park yourself by the door and you can take in the entire space. All their belongings, laid bare.

1m1xxpp.text: WELCOME to this chamber!! It is the largest room. This is where we all reside now.

067ojxu.raw: 'The entrance to this chamber is a hood. It closes with great dignity when the tide is low.'
067ojxu.text: The entrance to this chamber is a hood. It closes with great dignity when the tide is low.

1xk58h9.raw: 'The back wall of this chamber is an opening. That is all this chamber will say on the matter.'
1xk58h9.text: The back wall of this chamber is an opening. That is all this chamber will say on the matter.

1owvsxo.raw: '(Siphon will fight you here when you come back out through the rear.)'
1owvsxo.text: (Siphon will fight you here when you come back out through the rear.)

11urx34.raw: 'Enter through the opening in the back wall.'
11urx34.text: Enter through the opening in the back wall.

0swow8m.raw: 'This chamber is my first bowl now!! This chamber is far larger than that bowl was.'
0swow8m.text: This chamber is my first bowl now!! This chamber is far larger than that bowl was.

154cz8y.raw: 'My old mat lies within this chamber. The scent of being four years old is strongest here.'
154cz8y.text: My old mat lies within this chamber. The scent of being four years old is strongest here.

0ql8mrh.raw: 'This chamber now contains a drawing of itself. Drawn small, by a smaller version of me.'
0ql8mrh.text: This chamber now contains a drawing of itself. Drawn small, by a smaller version of me.

1u2qc1h.raw: 'Plenty of room here for a brawl! I\'ve got four whorls ready.'
1u2qc1h.text: Plenty of room here for a brawl! I've got four whorls ready.

1qwk4hg.raw: 'The floor near the hood is slick. I suggest you stay toward the dry side.'
1qwk4hg.text: The floor near the hood is slick. I suggest you stay toward the dry side.

0unyuvz.raw: 'This room offers warmth to those who have been beaten, until they thaw out.'
0unyuvz.text: This room offers warmth to those who have been beaten, until they thaw out.

01ur1ac.raw: 'A grain of tribute is awarded to whoever prevails here. Take it. Right here.'
01ur1ac.text: A grain of tribute is awarded to whoever prevails here. Take it. Right here.

0mtsmyq.raw: 'The hood is unlatching! The sea is receding, as it always does.'
0mtsmyq.text: The hood is unlatching! The sea is receding, as it always does.

1ifolyr.raw: 'This room owes you. It pays its debts in nacre.'
1ifolyr.text: This room owes you. It pays its debts in nacre.

0q36ozx.raw: 'The air is warmest near the fire, carrying that familiar scent of kelp.'
0q36ozx.text: The air is warmest near the fire, carrying that familiar scent of kelp.

1vo51kx.raw: 'The wet side is by the hood. It\'s always the hood side in here. Care to play?'

0lgkoby.text: Stay a while. It opens again at spring tide. I've got snacks.

01dbll8.raw: 'Rows of marks spiral upward to a point on the ceiling, with the lowest lines faded by age.'
01dbll8.text: Rows of marks spiral upward to a point on the ceiling, with the lowest lines faded by age.

1oqzu9i.raw: 'The floor is solid here. You hear better sitting down.'
1oqzu9i.text: The floor is solid here. You hear better sitting down.

1gaqkvc.raw: 'Sit on the floor so you can read the lower marks easily. They go back a long way.'
1gaqkvc.text: Sit on the floor so you can read the lower marks easily. They go back a long way.

0ebmvvp.raw: 'At high water, it was my gran\'s, most cherishedly. At low water, it is yours, most deservedly.'
0ebmvvp.text: At high water, it was my gran's, most cherishedly. At low water, it is yours, most deservedly.

0szac6v.text: At low tide, look for a brass object with rings in it among the eelgrass. It's a walking instrument.

150hz1h.raw: 'At my grandmother\'s low tide, it fell out of the hood. At some low tide since, it climbed back up.'
150hz1h.text: At my grandmother's low tide, it fell out of the hood. At some low tide since, it climbed back up.

1jmfivo.raw: 'At the spring high tide, the old rooms open.'
1jmfivo.text: At the spring high tide, the old rooms open.

049ldpp.raw: 'At this one, they are shut, just as they were at the last, and the one before-'
049ldpp.text: At this one, they are shut, just as they were at the last, and the one before-

0afkcmf.text: At this tide, you have time to escape through the siphon. Go around. Not back. Around.

0h39qag.raw: 'At half tide, you entered through the back!! No one does that. No one ever has.'
0h39qag.text: At half tide, you entered through the back!! No one does that. No one ever has.

1lia932.text: At every low tide since this room was the main hall, I have cut one mark. Faithfully.

1jh0e67.raw: 'At a high water, a pot hit the wall all over. Six marks scraped clean off!! A calamitous pot.'
1jh0e67.text: At a high water, a pot hit the wall all over. Six marks scraped clean off!! A calamitous pot.

03z9i4x.raw: 'At any tide you choose, cut them back for me. Here is the knife, my second-best.'
03z9i4x.text: At any tide you choose, cut them back for me. Here is the knife, my second-best.

1rybewm.raw: '(One to four notches for how far the sea went out. Find the pattern and cut the six blanks.)'
1rybewm.text: (One to four notches for how far the sea went out. Find the pattern and cut the six blanks.)

144ugxm.raw: 'Six blanks. Three by the point, three along the wall. The knife\'s yours till then.'
144ugxm.text: Six blanks. Three by the point, three along the wall. The knife's yours till then.

1xv5qjw.raw: 'Start with the newest by the point, oldest first: two notches. Then one. Then one. Then two.'
1xv5qjw.text: Start with the newest by the point, oldest first: two notches. Then one. Then one. Then two.

1c865h9.raw: 'Four, with a star. Four, with a star. Three. Two. One.'
1c865h9.text: Four, with a star. Four, with a star. Three. Two. One.

1cke072.raw: 'Then one, two, three, cut fresh. Then a place for the next.'
1cke072.text: Then one, two, three, cut fresh. Then a place for the next.

15u5py0.raw: 'Newest by the point, oldest first: two notches. Scraped. One. Two. Scraped.'
15u5py0.text: Newest by the point, oldest first: two notches. Scraped. One. Two. Scraped.

1iuvg79.raw: 'Four, and a star. Scraped. Three. Two. One.'
1iuvg79.text: Four, and a star. Scraped. Three. Two. One.

0mygu0h.text: Then three places were scraped smooth.

09o8ce1.raw: 'The sea never receded that far at low tide!! Never!! Scrape them and cut again.'
09o8ce1.text: The sea never receded that far at low tide!! Never!! Scrape them and cut again.

1tyiu06.text: At the next low, the sea retreats to its absolute limit. A spring low, the deepest of all.

0hci2w5.raw: 'During a spring low, the Gleaner traverses the entire beach.'
0hci2w5.text: During a spring low, the Gleaner traverses the entire beach.

1lru9uu.text: At the start of the ebb, it emerges from the pink shell at the beach's end.

13al8xr.raw: 'At half ebb, it reaches the sealed one, further up the beach. It lifts the shell, then sets it down.'

1gdhggi.raw: 'At the turn, it retreats into the pink shell and rests.'
1gdhggi.text: At the turn, it retreats into the pink shell and rests.

0g57xg8.text: For three hundred years, this has been the pattern at every spring low. So state the marks.

02fhznt.text: After that low, it moved with one hand. It has walked with one hand ever since.

1dpntl0.text: Escape through the siphon, near the low hole in the wall.

1inqben.text: This room is a valve on the left. It seals behind you, and it means it.

0ixcswa.text: To the nose, this room still smells of my mother's cooking, and it is a valve.

1fophh2.text: This room is two holes out and a valve. Eggs were kept here, arranged in rows.

0t4697u.text: (Each room you leave seals behind you. Traverse all six valve rooms and end at the door.)

1x117bo.text: This chamber lies on the other side of the door. It awaits you with great patience.

1l0esvy.text: Ha. This calls for sitting. My preferred method.

1n5sec3.text: I'll stay put. I can see you through the doorway from here, and that's enough.

17afx8m.text: Stay there, where I can watch you through the window.

130kc8j.text: Up. Then down. Up. Then down. My knees are complaining about the big low.

086cflo.text: Inside, climbers ascend and descend simultaneously, filling the stairs.

03pg4zw.text: A total wreck, overturned on sand that nobody here has seen dry.

0yytn6y.raw: 'Weeds sprawl across it. Something in the hold breathes slowly.'
0yytn6y.text: Weeds sprawl across it. Something in the hold breathes slowly.

1q54h1n.text: The anchor stone. The sea has receded so far that its hollow is filled with stars.

0e422u4.text: High along the shore, a hand lifts the Volute from the sand.

1ave6b4.raw: 'The hand raises the Volute to the height of an ear.'
1ave6b4.text: The hand raises the Volute to the height of an ear.

1cfdbny.text: Follow the footprints east, along the upper beach.

0bgzca6.text: Look at that big low! Once a year, you get to run right behind the stars! Come on, come on!

05mtyz9.text: Alright, alright, you win. Now, run!

1jf50lt.text: I flip the jellies over so they don't dry out. Do they say thank you? No, they don't.

08ud6pt.text: Yeah, don't expect any gratitude from them.

1f5yqf9.text: A label stuck in a dune, made of driftwood, with large letters that lean and grow toward the end.

0q0s597.text: A label. Something has scratched small letters beneath the main text: "not this one".

1orew99.text: Tucked into the lee of a dune, sheltered from the wind, lies a nautilus horn and a notion.

0i0xro0.raw: 'Low tide. Look at all that sand. Nothing\'s coming to take any of it.'
0i0xro0.text: Low tide. Look at all that sand. Nothing's coming to take any of it.

0z284o5.text: High tide. KEEP THE SEA's under the sea now. Only one out here got what it asked for.

1emns1f.text: I just read them, that's my job. The first word is always KEEP. After THE, it gets tricky.

0jqyqex.text: The old ones are neat and small. The new ones are huge. It really hurts my neck.

0gmly9r.text: I never stay put in one shell. I don't skip ahead, either. I always move to the adjacent one.

0v8mri3.text: Huh. I don't usually lose that one. But I don't mind. Not really.

0carrzo.text: Here are the rules, if you're sticking around. No labeled shells.

0ubvamt.raw: 'And don\'t stand up during dead low tide.'
0ubvamt.text: And don't stand up during dead low tide.

0rm87vz.text: Plus, I never look up at it. I don't need to.

0jm7hbi.text: Once you learn the rhythm of the feet, you never forget it.

0cgbllo.text: The posts are white and rounded at the top. They stand as tall as the corner posts at the Margin.

0hvzdtm.text: I keep away from the big square. I've never seen anything in it. Not once.

19f6n89.text: I listened down every row. Just once. I'm not doing it again.
