044615r.raw: 'A whorl is a creature that fights for you. Your team consists of the whorls you take with you. A team can have 4 whorls.'
044615r.text: A whorl is a creature that fights for you. Your team consists of the whorls you take with you. A team can have 4 whorls.

1jrscxz.raw: 'The first whorl in your lineup is your lead. Your lead walks with you and is the first to enter battle.'
1jrscxz.text: The first whorl in your lineup is your lead. Your lead walks with you and is the first to enter battle.

0wfxiq4.raw: 'Only one whorl fights at a time. This is your out whorl, while the others remain in reserve.'
0wfxiq4.text: Only one whorl fights at a time. This is your out whorl, while the others remain in reserve.

0i4lf7x.raw: 'Select Switch during a battle to bring a whorl from reserve into action. Switching is swift. The incoming whorl waits less time than it would after an Attack. Higher CHA reduces this waiting period even further.'
0i4lf7x.text: Select Switch during a battle to bring a whorl from reserve into action. Switching is swift. The incoming whorl waits less time than it would after an Attack. Higher CHA reduces this waiting period even further.

1h3i1rv.raw: 'A whorl that is rooted or taunted cannot be switched out.'
1h3i1rv.text: A whorl that is rooted or taunted cannot be switched out.

1h2wp0b.raw: 'A whorl with 0 HP is knocked out. The game calls this down or a KO. It cannot fight again in that battle. Pick the next whorl to send out.'
1h2wp0b.text: A whorl with 0 HP is knocked out. The game calls this down or a KO. It cannot fight again in that battle. Pick the next whorl to send out.

0uj53xd.raw: 'Battles begin with full HP. A KO\'d whorl is fine when the battle ends.'
0uj53xd.text: Battles begin with full HP. A KO'd whorl is fine when the battle ends.

0c5xine.raw: 'If your entire team is defeated, you lose the battle. You will lose 20% of your cowries and respawn at the last grotto you visited. Grottos are the shops found in every town.'
0c5xine.text: If your entire team is defeated, you lose the battle. You will lose 20% of your cowries and respawn at the last grotto you visited. Grottos are the shops found in every town.

00l1a5b.raw: 'When your team is full, any new whorls you catch are sent to the Midden. You can access the Midden from any grotto, where you can swap whorls in and out of your active team.'
00l1a5b.text: When your team is full, any new whorls you catch are sent to the Midden. You can access the Midden from any grotto, where you can swap whorls in and out of your active team.

0qe5jfo.raw: 'Press X to open the menu, select Team, choose a whorl, then pick Make lead.'
0qe5jfo.text: Press X to open the menu, select Team, choose a whorl, then pick Make lead.

0e42ikp.raw: 'Each whorl has seven stats. A stat is a number. It shows how good the whorl is at one thing.'
0e42ikp.text: Each whorl has seven stats. A stat is a number. It shows how good the whorl is at one thing.

1niee80.raw: 'HP is health. A whorl with 0 HP is knocked out. Max HP is the most health it can have.'
1niee80.text: HP is health. A whorl with 0 HP is knocked out. Max HP is the most health it can have.

1uwbntp.raw: 'DEF makes physical hits do less damage.'
1uwbntp.text: DEF makes physical hits do less damage.

0pgy7qb.text: RES makes magic hits hurt less.

0fsriwh.raw: 'Speed is AGI. A whorl with more AGI takes more turns.'
0fsriwh.text: Speed is AGI. A whorl with more AGI takes more turns.

09uez61.raw: 'CHA helps a horn catch whorls. It also reduces the wait time after using a Switch. Some moves use CHA too.'
09uez61.text: CHA helps a horn catch whorls. It also reduces the wait time after using a Switch. Some moves use CHA too.

1p27oiq.raw: 'Every species is strong in different ways. One might have more ATK. Another might have more DEF. They also have different moves, habits, and types.'
1p27oiq.text: Every species is strong in different ways. One might have more ATK. Another might have more DEF. They also have different moves, habits, and types.

178946e.raw: 'All species get the same number of stat points. They use them in different ways. A fast species has less DEF. A tough species gets fewer turns. A conjoined whorl gets half its points from each of the two old whorls.'
178946e.text: All species get the same number of stat points. They use them in different ways. A fast species has less DEF. A tough species gets fewer turns. A conjoined whorl gets half its points from each of the two old whorls.

136hz8p.raw: 'This picture shows your lead\'s stats. The stats go up when a whorl levels up. You can find things later that raise them a little more.'
136hz8p.text: This picture shows your lead's stats. The stats go up when a whorl levels up. You can find things later that raise them a little more.

0rlbygh.raw: 'Many texts use the % sign. It means parts of 100. 50% is half. 25% is one quarter. 10% is one tenth.'
0rlbygh.text: Many texts use the % sign. It means parts of 100. 50% is half. 25% is one quarter. 10% is one tenth.

1lyryir.raw: 'Every whorl has a simple Attack. It is either physical or magic. Physical Attacks use ATK. Magic Attacks use MGK.'
1lyryir.text: Every whorl has a simple Attack. It is either physical or magic. Physical Attacks use ATK. Magic Attacks use MGK.

034wdnd.raw: 'The move\'s text tells you which stat it uses. Hitting for 110% ATK is a physical hit. Hitting for 90% MGK is a magic hit.'
034wdnd.text: The move's text tells you which stat it uses. Hitting for 110% ATK is a physical hit. Hitting for 90% MGK is a magic hit.

1y2mkcl.raw: 'DEF and RES make hits hurt less. Say a hit has 100 power. It does 70 damage to a whorl with 42 DEF. It does 50 damage to a whorl with 100 DEF.'
1y2mkcl.text: DEF and RES make hits hurt less. Say a hit has 100 power. It does 70 damage to a whorl with 42 DEF. It does 50 damage to a whorl with 100 DEF.

0uqlvzg.raw: 'DEF works best against physical whorls. RES works best against magic whorls.'
0uqlvzg.text: DEF works best against physical whorls. RES works best against magic whorls.

12ngh60.raw: 'Press X to see stats. Tap Team, pick the whorl, then tap Look.'
12ngh60.text: Press X to see stats. Tap Team, pick the whorl, then tap Look.

1jwzyzu.raw: 'In combat, a whorl pauses after taking an action. Higher AGI reduces this pause. Thus, a quicker whorl gains additional turns.'
1jwzyzu.text: In combat, a whorl pauses after taking an action. Higher AGI reduces this pause. Thus, a quicker whorl gains additional turns.

1tuzb5s.raw: 'Example: Your whorl has 69 AGI, while the foe has 51. Throughout the battle, your whorl gains roughly 9 turns for every 8 the foe gets.'
1tuzb5s.text: Example: Your whorl has 69 AGI, while the foe has 51. Throughout the battle, your whorl gains roughly 9 turns for every 8 the foe gets.

01q6u95.raw: 'Typically, turns occur in close succession, meaning both sides choose their actions simultaneously. Neither party can see the other\'s selection at that moment.'
01q6u95.text: Typically, turns occur in close succession, meaning both sides choose their actions simultaneously. Neither party can see the other's selection at that moment.

0sbiscg.raw: 'Actions resolve in order. The whorl whose turn comes first goes first. The top line indicates who moves first.'
0sbiscg.text: Actions resolve in order. The whorl whose turn comes first goes first. The top line indicates who moves first.

130lgnl.raw: 'Guard and Switch always go first. Quick moves follow. Late moves wait until the foe has acted.'
130lgnl.text: Guard and Switch always go first. Quick moves follow. Late moves wait until the foe has acted.

0ne8ati.raw: 'Guess the foe\'s move. If a big hit is coming, Guard. If the foe Guards, use a dash. If they use TIDE, switch to a whorl resistant to it.'
0ne8ati.text: Guess the foe's move. If a big hit is coming, Guard. If the foe Guards, use a dash. If they use TIDE, switch to a whorl resistant to it.

0ht0blm.raw: 'Sometimes one side moves much sooner. That side picks alone and moves. So a fast whorl can move twice before a slow one moves once. The top line shows when this happens.'
0ht0blm.text: Sometimes one side moves much sooner. That side picks alone and moves. So a fast whorl can move twice before a slow one moves once. The top line shows when this happens.

0qf1xxk.raw: 'Some actions have short waits. A whorl waits 80% as long after Guard as after Attack. The incoming whorl waits about 70%. More CHA shortens this wait. The Switch list shows the wait for each whorl.'
0qf1xxk.text: Some actions have short waits. A whorl waits 80% as long after Guard as after Attack. The incoming whorl waits about 70%. More CHA shortens this wait. The Switch list shows the wait for each whorl.

1obvbjt.raw: 'Slow 1 delays the whorl\'s next turn. It waits 30% of a turn more. Slow 2 does this for its next 2 turns.'
1obvbjt.text: Slow 1 delays the whorl's next turn. It waits 30% of a turn more. Slow 2 does this for its next 2 turns.

0ybdxjp.raw: 'Haste operates in the opposite manner, causing each subsequent turn to arrive 30% of a turn earlier.'
0ybdxjp.text: Haste operates in the opposite manner, causing each subsequent turn to arrive 30% of a turn earlier.

0h6ajqx.raw: 'A slowed foe often goes last. Slow it twice, and you may get a turn.'
0h6ajqx.text: A slowed foe often goes last. Slow it twice, and you may get a turn.

0waucbi.raw: 'Some text says the whorl\'s next turn comes 40% sooner. This means the whorl waits less before it moves again. The wait is about 40% shorter.'
0waucbi.text: Some text says the whorl's next turn comes 40% sooner. This means the whorl waits less before it moves again. The wait is about 40% shorter.

0uu626p.raw: 'Some moves change the field for a few rounds. Sea Fog and High Tide are examples. The field affects both sides, so it can help the foe too.'
0uu626p.text: Some moves change the field for a few rounds. Sea Fog and High Tide are examples. The field affects both sides, so it can help the foe too.

06plks6.raw: 'A wind-up move lands later. A ! appears over the whorl while winding up. The top line shows how many moves you get first.'
06plks6.text: A wind-up move lands later. A ! appears over the whorl while winding up. The top line shows how many moves you get first.

01v7l2b.raw: 'You can stop a foe\'s wind-up. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or Taunt cuts it off. Forcing the foe out also stops it.'
01v7l2b.text: You can stop a foe's wind-up. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or Taunt cuts it off. Forcing the foe out also stops it.

16zyhos.raw: 'You can also switch to a whorl that takes less damage from the move. An Unstoppable wind-up cannot be interrupted.'
16zyhos.text: You can also switch to a whorl that takes less damage from the move. An Unstoppable wind-up cannot be interrupted.

1v0fh4o.raw: 'A round consists of one turn per side. The field tracks the rounds, as does any prolonged battle.'
1v0fh4o.text: A round consists of one turn per side. The field tracks the rounds, as does any prolonged battle.

0qb4bnu.raw: 'On your turn, choose one action: Attack, use a move, Guard, or Switch.'
0qb4bnu.text: On your turn, choose one action: Attack, use a move, Guard, or Switch.

03kvu3q.raw: 'Attack is your whorl\'s standard strike. You can use it every turn, and it never depletes. Since it has no type, it deals equal damage to all types.'
03kvu3q.text: Attack is your whorl's standard strike. You can use it every turn, and it never depletes. Since it has no type, it deals equal damage to all types.

1drxrtt.raw: 'Attacks can strike more than once. A habit that functions after an Attack still works once for the entire Attack. A habit that mentions hits applies to each hit.'
1drxrtt.text: Attacks can strike more than once. A habit that functions after an Attack still works once for the entire Attack. A habit that mentions hits applies to each hit.

0smqsiu.raw: 'Each whorl has four moves. These moves deal more damage or provide special effects. Review the move\'s description before selecting it to understand its effect.'
0smqsiu.text: Each whorl has four moves. These moves deal more damage or provide special effects. Review the move's description before selecting it to understand its effect.

10mx4hu.raw: 'Hits for 110% ATK means a hit with 1.1 times the whorl\'s ATK. Slow 1 means the foe is slowed for 1 turn.'
10mx4hu.text: Hits for 110% ATK means a hit with 1.1 times the whorl's ATK. Slow 1 means the foe is slowed for 1 turn.

0bpzu3g.raw: 'After using a move, it must recharge. This recharge period is its cooldown, and the menu displays the remaining turns.'
0bpzu3g.text: After using a move, it must recharge. This recharge period is its cooldown, and the menu displays the remaining turns.

0zgjawx.raw: 'Flatten\'s cooldown is 3. Squall uses it. It rests for Squall\'s next 3 turns. It\'s ready on turn 4.'
0zgjawx.text: Flatten's cooldown is 3. Squall uses it. It rests for Squall's next 3 turns. It's ready on turn 4.

1tcii43.raw: 'Cooldowns count your side\'s turns. They decrease while the whorl waits in reserve.'
1tcii43.text: Cooldowns count your side's turns. They decrease while the whorl waits in reserve.

0a914uy.raw: 'Moves matching a whorl\'s own type deal 20% more damage. Squall is a TIDE whorl, so its TIDE moves deal 20% more damage.'
0a914uy.text: Moves matching a whorl's own type deal 20% more damage. Squall is a TIDE whorl, so its TIDE moves deal 20% more damage.

1cm5at0.raw: 'Some moves splash damage. The primary target takes full damage, while each foe in reserve takes a portion. The move description specifies the percentage.'
1cm5at0.text: Some moves splash damage. The primary target takes full damage, while each foe in reserve takes a portion. The move description specifies the percentage.

01k343e.raw: 'Splash 35% means each foe in reserve takes 35% of the damage. A small splash is called a spray. Splash 100% damages the entire enemy team equally.'
01k343e.text: Splash 35% means each foe in reserve takes 35% of the damage. A small splash is called a spray. Splash 100% damages the entire enemy team equally.

1jn5ylj.raw: 'Guard reduces the damage your whorl takes by half. It lasts until your whorl\'s next turn. A Guard always acts first in a round.'
1jn5ylj.text: Guard reduces the damage your whorl takes by half. It lasts until your whorl's next turn. A Guard always acts first in a round.

1fdnddl.raw: 'Guard blocks a larger share of a projectile but does not block a dash at all.'
1fdnddl.text: Guard blocks a larger share of a projectile but does not block a dash at all.

09x8n3a.raw: 'You cannot Guard on consecutive turns. Additionally, Guarding is a swift action.'
09x8n3a.text: You cannot Guard on consecutive turns. Additionally, Guarding is a swift action.

0ny50vg.raw: 'Many moves have a kind. A small icon shows it. Each kind has one rule.'
0ny50vg.text: Many moves have a kind. A small icon shows it. Each kind has one rule.

1njutqu.raw: 'A dash strikes quickly. Until its next turn, the whorl takes 10% less damage. Guard does not block a dash. A rooted whorl cannot dash.'
1njutqu.text: A dash strikes quickly. Until its next turn, the whorl takes 10% less damage. Guard does not block a dash. A rooted whorl cannot dash.

1b0ceby.raw: 'A projectile flies through the air. A guarding whorl takes only a quarter of the damage.'
1b0ceby.text: A projectile flies through the air. A guarding whorl takes only a quarter of the damage.

1l42rcv.raw: 'Spells bypass walls raised by summons. A silenced whorl cannot cast spells.'
1l42rcv.text: Spells bypass walls raised by summons. A silenced whorl cannot cast spells.

1mlrdv2.raw: 'Channeling persists across turns. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or Switch interrupts it.'
1mlrdv2.text: Channeling persists across turns. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or Switch interrupts it.

0vrjr6s.raw: 'Each whorl has two habits. Habits act automatically. You do not select them. In battle, press left or right on the menu to view habits.'
0vrjr6s.text: Each whorl has two habits. Habits act automatically. You do not select them. In battle, press left or right on the menu to view habits.

0l7r7qk.raw: 'A crest is a whorl\'s ultimate move. Most whorls have one crest. Crests cost tide.'
0l7r7qk.text: A crest is a whorl's ultimate move. Most whorls have one crest. Crests cost tide.

06ro1sy.raw: `Tide is a shared resource for your team. It holds up to ${NERVE_MAX}. Each battle starts with 2 tide.`
06ro1sy.text: Tide is a shared resource for your team. It holds up to {NERVE_MAX}. Each battle starts with 2 tide.

18t3lzs.raw: 'When a move hits a guarding whorl, its side gains 1 tide. This applies once per Guard.'
18t3lzs.text: When a move hits a guarding whorl, its side gains 1 tide. This applies once per Guard.

1c35mjo.raw: 'Certain moves, habits, and notions also grant tide.'
1c35mjo.text: Certain moves, habits, and notions also grant tide.

0e6dq1y.raw: 'Cloudburst is Squall\'s crest. It costs 5 tide. You start with 2. Land 3 Attacks, and you have 5.'
0e6dq1y.text: Cloudburst is Squall's crest. It costs 5 tide. You start with 2. Land 3 Attacks, and you have 5.

0s2nh6s.raw: 'Enemies have their own tide pool. Watch it. When full, they may use a crest.'
0s2nh6s.text: Enemies have their own tide pool. Watch it. When full, they may use a crest.

0a2ht0e.raw: 'A crest also has a cooldown, like any other move.'
0a2ht0e.text: A crest also has a cooldown, like any other move.

05z1k3w.raw: 'Every whorl has one or two types. Every move has one type. Types determine strengths and weaknesses.'
05z1k3w.text: Every whorl has one or two types. Every move has one type. Types determine strengths and weaknesses.

15zjicw.raw: 'There are six types: STONE, TIDE, ROOT, GEAR, BEAST, and STAR.'
15zjicw.text: There are six types: STONE, TIDE, ROOT, GEAR, BEAST, and STAR.

0t9wx3j.raw: 'Rows show move types. Columns show foe types. Plus means strong. Minus means weak.'
0t9wx3j.text: Rows show move types. Columns show foe types. Plus means strong. Minus means weak.

0yq1q3m.raw: 'Super effective hits deal 1.5 times the normal damage, while weak hits deal roughly two-thirds.'
0yq1q3m.text: Super effective hits deal 1.5 times the normal damage, while weak hits deal roughly two-thirds.

04gpv1f.raw: 'For example, TIDE is strong against STONE. This means Squall\'s Rain Shot hits Kivishi for 1.5 times the damage, while Kivishi\'s STONE moves deal only two-thirds damage to Squall.'
04gpv1f.text: For example, TIDE is strong against STONE. This means Squall's Rain Shot hits Kivishi for 1.5 times the damage, while Kivishi's STONE moves deal only two-thirds damage to Squall.

0zc3aoo.raw: 'A dual-type whorl counts both. If both are weak to a move, it hits 2 times as hard. A strong one and a weak one cancel out. A hit never does more than 2 times, or less than half.'
0zc3aoo.text: A dual-type whorl counts both. If both are weak to a move, it hits 2 times as hard. A strong one and a weak one cancel out. A hit never does more than 2 times, or less than half.

179lcm5.raw: 'When a hit lands, the battle log shows strong or weak. Before you pick a move, look at it. It tells you when the foe is weak to it.'
179lcm5.text: When a hit lands, the battle log shows strong or weak. Before you pick a move, look at it. It tells you when the foe is weak to it.

0ac14w0.raw: 'A plain Attack has no type. Damage from statuses also has no type.'
0ac14w0.text: A plain Attack has no type. Damage from statuses also has no type.

1tnlxth.raw: 'Statuses are short-term whorl effects, shown by an icon near its HP bar.'
1tnlxth.text: Statuses are short-term whorl effects, shown by an icon near its HP bar.

00usk04.raw: 'Status durations are shown by the number following them. Slow 2 lasts for 2 of the whorl\'s turns. Bleed and Poison use numbers for stack count.'
00usk04.text: Status durations are shown by the number following them. Slow 2 lasts for 2 of the whorl's turns. Bleed and Poison use numbers for stack count.

02rohue.raw: 'Stun: The whorl loses its next turn. Stun also cuts off a wind-up.'
02rohue.text: Stun: The whorl loses its next turn. Stun also cuts off a wind-up.

0pjuzsf.raw: 'Sleep: The whorl skips turns. It wakes if hit.'
0pjuzsf.text: Sleep: The whorl skips turns. It wakes if hit.

0nxjnqr.raw: 'Silence. The whorl cannot cast spells, but its other abilities remain active.'
0nxjnqr.text: Silence. The whorl cannot cast spells, but its other abilities remain active.

1xd2m30.raw: 'Taunt. The whorl is restricted to using only Attack.'
1xd2m30.text: Taunt. The whorl is restricted to using only Attack.

1s2cand.raw: 'Root. The whorl is unable to switch out or dash.'
1s2cand.text: Root. The whorl is unable to switch out or dash.

14d6knm.raw: 'Slow. Each subsequent turn of the whorl arrives 30% of a turn later.'
14d6knm.text: Slow. Each subsequent turn of the whorl arrives 30% of a turn later.

0pgigme.raw: 'Burn. The whorl suffers magic damage at the start of each turn.'
0pgigme.text: Burn. The whorl suffers magic damage at the start of each turn.

0bliims.raw: 'Bleed. The whorl takes physical damage at the start of each turn and loses one stack.'
0bliims.text: Bleed. The whorl takes physical damage at the start of each turn and loses one stack.

12mrwac.raw: 'Poison. At the start of each turn, the whorl loses 3% of its maximum HP per stack, then loses one stack.'
12mrwac.text: Poison. At the start of each turn, the whorl loses 3% of its maximum HP per stack, then loses one stack.

0l44aip.raw: 'Rot. The whorl receives half the normal amount of healing.'
0l44aip.text: Rot. The whorl receives half the normal amount of healing.

067mdlf.raw: 'Expose. Increases damage taken by the whorl by 25%.'
067mdlf.text: Expose. Increases damage taken by the whorl by 25%.

1czyzem.raw: 'Weaken. Reduces the damage dealt by the whorl by 25%.'
1czyzem.text: Weaken. Reduces the damage dealt by the whorl by 25%.

1frqe2g.raw: 'Doom. The whorl takes damage every turn and cannot heal or use moves.'
1frqe2g.text: Doom. The whorl takes damage every turn and cannot heal or use moves.

12nmga8.raw: 'If a foe inflicts Stun, Sleep, Stasis, a forced skip, or a forced switch, the whorl loses its turn but then becomes immune to that specific effect. It cannot be affected by the same status again until it has acted.'
12nmga8.text: If a foe inflicts Stun, Sleep, Stasis, a forced skip, or a forced switch, the whorl loses its turn but then becomes immune to that specific effect. It cannot be affected by the same status again until it has acted.

14kigzf.raw: 'Another effect can still land before it acts. Once both expire, the whorl becomes stalwart. For its next 2 turns, it cannot be forced to lose a turn.'
14kigzf.text: Another effect can still land before it acts. Once both expire, the whorl becomes stalwart. For its next 2 turns, it cannot be forced to lose a turn.

01ksppu.raw: 'A forced switch occurs when an opponent forces the whorl to change. The whorl may be forced out, dragged in, spun around, or switched at its next turn. The replacement whorl also counts as forced.'
01ksppu.text: A forced switch occurs when an opponent forces the whorl to change. The whorl may be forced out, dragged in, spun around, or switched at its next turn. The replacement whorl also counts as forced.

1k5se6h.raw: 'Haste. Each of the whorl\'s subsequent turns arrives 30% of a turn earlier.'
1k5se6h.text: Haste. Each of the whorl's subsequent turns arrives 30% of a turn earlier.

176q3wc.raw: 'Dashing. After dashing, the whorl takes 10% less damage until its next turn.'
176q3wc.text: Dashing. After dashing, the whorl takes 10% less damage until its next turn.

0k6rjv6.text: Empower: The whorl deals 25% more damage.

0rawd6j.text: Fortify: The whorl takes 25% less damage.

1m9r3lz.raw: 'Regen: The whorl heals slightly at the start of each turn.'
1m9r3lz.text: Regen: The whorl heals slightly at the start of each turn.

0wk8n58.raw: 'Ward blocks the foe\'s next attack on the whorl. It fades after 2 turns if unused.'
0wk8n58.text: Ward blocks the foe's next attack on the whorl. It fades after 2 turns if unused.

1df8dov.raw: 'Thorns. When the whorl is struck, it retaliates for a portion of the damage dealt.'
1df8dov.text: Thorns. When the whorl is struck, it retaliates for a portion of the damage dealt.

1wq7keu.raw: 'Untouchable. The whorl takes no damage. Applying another instance of Untouchable does not extend its duration. The whorl is Seen through its next turn after Untouchable ends. Until then, it cannot gain Hidden or become Untouchable again.'
1wq7keu.text: Untouchable. The whorl takes no damage. Applying another instance of Untouchable does not extend its duration. The whorl is Seen through its next turn after Untouchable ends. Until then, it cannot gain Hidden or become Untouchable again.

0gfxzcd.raw: 'Unstoppable. It is immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, Taunt, and Slow.'
0gfxzcd.text: Unstoppable. It is immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, Taunt, and Slow.

0rcrvte.raw: 'Stasis. The whorl skips its turns. It cannot be damaged or inflicted with status effects.'
0rcrvte.text: Stasis. The whorl skips its turns. It cannot be damaged or inflicted with status effects.

04m4aii.raw: 'Hidden. A foe\'s single hits cannot find it. Its own next hit goes through Guard. The whorl is Revealed through its next turn after Hidden ends. Until then it cannot become Hidden or Untouchable.'
04m4aii.text: Hidden. A foe's single hits cannot find it. Its own next hit goes through Guard. The whorl is Revealed through its next turn after Hidden ends. Until then it cannot become Hidden or Untouchable.

1aasx9w.raw: 'Monument. The whorl cannot be knocked out. It remains at 1 HP.'
1aasx9w.text: Monument. The whorl cannot be knocked out. It remains at 1 HP.

1l53dzl.raw: 'When a whorl is replaced, it loses most status effects. Burn, Bleed, Poison, Rot, Doom, Ward, Regen, and Hidden persist.'
1l53dzl.text: When a whorl is replaced, it loses most status effects. Burn, Bleed, Poison, Rot, Doom, Ward, Regen, and Hidden persist.

051k9c1.raw: 'A mark is a sign that some moves place on a whorl. Each species has its own marks. Kivishi gains a Stone each time it is hit.'
051k9c1.text: A mark is a sign that some moves place on a whorl. Each species has its own marks. Kivishi gains a Stone each time it is hit.

1csx1z9.raw: 'A diamond icon by the HP bar shows the mark\'s stack count.'
1csx1z9.text: A diamond icon by the HP bar shows the mark's stack count.

104isuk.raw: 'To learn what a mark does, check the habits of the whorl that generates it. In battle, press left or right on the menu to view this information.'
104isuk.text: To learn what a mark does, check the habits of the whorl that generates it. In battle, press left or right on the menu to view this information.

17leij9.raw: 'Some marks fade after a few turns. Others disappear when the whorl switches out.'
17leij9.text: Some marks fade after a few turns. Others disappear when the whorl switches out.

0iqlst0.raw: 'Some moves summon a helper to the field. This summon stays by its whorl and has its own small HP bar.'
0iqlst0.text: Some moves summon a helper to the field. This summon stays by its whorl and has its own small HP bar.

1bgiufj.raw: `Each side holds ${SUMMON_CAP} summons. New ones displace the oldest.`
1bgiufj.text: Each side holds {SUMMON_CAP} summons. New ones displace the oldest.

0aklvz1.raw: 'Summons act independently. Some attack foes, while others protect their whorl. Protective summons absorb single-hit attacks intended for their whorl.'
0aklvz1.text: Summons act independently. Some attack foes, while others protect their whorl. Protective summons absorb single-hit attacks intended for their whorl.

0vrrkdc.raw: 'Summons have no DEF or RES. Any damage dealt to them is reduced by half.'
0vrrkdc.text: Summons have no DEF or RES. Any damage dealt to them is reduced by half.

01c36t7.raw: 'You can target specific summons. When choosing Attack, select the summon instead of the whorl.'
01c36t7.text: You can target specific summons. When choosing Attack, select the summon instead of the whorl.

1ji9hqy.raw: 'Summons disappear when their HP reaches zero. Some also vanish after a set number of turns.'
1ji9hqy.text: Summons disappear when their HP reaches zero. Some also vanish after a set number of turns.

0x7exn4.raw: 'Shields add extra HP above your bar, absorbing hits first. They appear as a pale line and fade after a few turns.'
0x7exn4.text: Shields add extra HP above your bar, absorbing hits first. They appear as a pale line and fade after a few turns.

05hm1r6.raw: 'You can capture a wild whorl using a horn. Once caught, it joins your team.'
05hm1r6.text: You can capture a wild whorl using a horn. Once caught, it joins your team.

06bso2b.raw: 'Select Catch to grab a wild whorl, then choose a horn. You can only catch wild whorls.'
06bso2b.text: Select Catch to grab a wild whorl, then choose a horn. You can only catch wild whorls.

0qnq4jt.raw: 'Each horn has a threshold line. If the foe\'s HP is at or below it, the horn always succeeds.'
0qnq4jt.text: Each horn has a threshold line. If the foe's HP is at or below it, the horn always succeeds.

0mbqsxh.raw: 'Selecting Catch displays each horn\'s success rate. "Sure" indicates it cannot fail.'
0mbqsxh.text: Selecting Catch displays each horn's success rate. "Sure" indicates it cannot fail.

0bmd4v4.raw: `Periwinkle horn. The threshold is set at ${pct(HORN_LINE.twig)}%. It costs ${HORN_PRICE.twig} cowries.`
0bmd4v4.text: Periwinkle horn. The threshold is set at {#1}%. It costs {HORN_PRICE.twig} cowries.

1uql2xr.raw: `Whelk horn. The threshold is set at ${pct(HORN_LINE.brass)}%. It costs ${HORN_PRICE.brass} cowries.`
1uql2xr.text: Whelk horn. The threshold is set at {#1}%. It costs {HORN_PRICE.brass} cowries.

1rdlbhq.raw: `Triton horn. The threshold is set at ${pct(HORN_LINE.bone)}%. It costs ${HORN_PRICE.bone} cowries.`
1rdlbhq.text: Triton horn. The threshold is set at {#1}%. It costs {HORN_PRICE.bone} cowries.

1ok7uo7.raw: 'Nautilus horn. It always succeeds. You can find these, but they are not sold in shops.'
1ok7uo7.text: Nautilus horn. It always succeeds. You can find these, but they are not sold in shops.

1p2rxnt.raw: `Above the threshold, a horn may still succeed. The lower the foe's HP, the higher the chance. A Periwinkle horn guarantees at least a ${pct(HORN_FLOOR.twig)}% chance.`
1p2rxnt.text: Above the threshold, a horn may still succeed. The lower the foe's HP, the higher the chance. A Periwinkle horn guarantees at least a {#1}% chance.

1xihcuo.raw: 'First, weaken the foe, but do not defeat it. A wild whorl that is knocked out will escape.'
1xihcuo.text: First, weaken the foe, but do not defeat it. A wild whorl that is knocked out will escape.

19gpf9i.raw: `Certain factors improve your odds. If the foe is stunned or asleep, the threshold increases by ${pct(HORN_HELD)}%. If your whorl has higher CHA than the foe, the threshold rises by up to ${pct(HORN_CHA_MAX)}%. Lower CHA reduces the threshold.`
19gpf9i.text: Certain factors improve your odds. If the foe is stunned or asleep, the threshold increases by {#1}%. If your whorl has higher CHA than the foe, the threshold rises by up to {#2}%. Lower CHA reduces the threshold.

0pouokd.raw: 'If the horn fails, you still lose your turn.'
0pouokd.text: If the horn fails, you still lose your turn.

14e2wm0.raw: 'If your team is full, the newly captured whorl is sent to the Midden.'
14e2wm0.text: If your team is full, the newly captured whorl is sent to the Midden.

185pztv.raw: 'When fighting a wild whorl, you can always choose to Run. Run always works.'
185pztv.text: When fighting a wild whorl, you can always choose to Run. Run always works.

1gi5gwy.raw: 'A notion is a small item held by a whorl. Each whorl can hold one notion.'
1gi5gwy.text: A notion is a small item held by a whorl. Each whorl can hold one notion.

1cnwnib.raw: 'Some notions boost a stat. For instance, a Whetstone adds 11% ATK. Other notions change how a whorl fights. Bloodglass heals the whorl slightly each time it deals damage.'
1cnwnib.text: Some notions boost a stat. For instance, a Whetstone adds 11% ATK. Other notions change how a whorl fights. Bloodglass heals the whorl slightly each time it deals damage.

0dh1tz3.raw: 'To give a notion, press X to open the menu. Select Team, then a whorl, then Give notion. Take notion returns it to the Bag.'
0dh1tz3.text: To give a notion, press X to open the menu. Select Team, then a whorl, then Give notion. Take notion returns it to the Bag.

1ek6pzz.raw: 'Some notions trigger an action. This appears as a choice in the battle menu. It can be used once per battle and acts quickly, similar to a Switch.'
1ek6pzz.text: Some notions trigger an action. This appears as a choice in the battle menu. It can be used once per battle and acts quickly, similar to a Switch.

146e7c2.raw: 'Some notions are consumed upon use. A Sea Biscuit restores 35% of the whorl\'s HP. After that battle, the Sea Biscuit is gone.'
146e7c2.text: Some notions are consumed upon use. A Sea Biscuit restores 35% of the whorl's HP. After that battle, the Sea Biscuit is gone.

1h6evgg.raw: 'You can purchase notions at a grotto. Read the description of each item in your Bag before using it.'
1h6evgg.text: You can purchase notions at a grotto. Read the description of each item in your Bag before using it.

0jd9a7h.raw: 'Nacre is the shiny inner lining of a shell. You can find it in hidden spots. Some trainers will give you a piece of nacre after you win. Each piece represents one layer.'
0jd9a7h.text: Nacre is the shiny inner lining of a shell. You can find it in hidden spots. Some trainers will give you a piece of nacre after you win. Each piece represents one layer.

0lbirpr.text: At a grotto, pick Nacre. Then layer nacre on a whorl. Each layer adds the same points to any stat, helping a weak stat just as much as a strong one.
