0u2peqg.text: The Riders' model of the sky. It circles. It makes your lot go round quicker. Six cowries, which is cheap for a sky.

0lr118u.raw: 'From a dock. It lifts what lies beneath and places it where it pleases. It put my cart on the roof. Four cowries, cart stays.'
0lr118u.text: From a dock. It lifts what lies beneath and places it where it pleases. It put my cart on the roof. Four cowries, cart stays.

0ke4bt6.raw: 'This one faces the wind and creates breezes for its companions. Hold your three cowries tight when you pay.'
0ke4bt6.text: This one faces the wind and creates breezes for its companions. Hold your three cowries tight when you pay.

0s4u9j3.raw: 'Fell from the sky one winter. It watches from the spot where it landed. It will watch you count out six cowries, so count correctly.'
0s4u9j3.text: Fell from the sky one winter. It watches from the spot where it landed. It will watch you count out six cowries, so count correctly.

1tplisp.raw: 'From the old works, with something alive inside the firebox. It stays warm for a hundred years. Three cowries, or two and your blanket.'
1tplisp.text: From the old works, with something alive inside the firebox. It stays warm for a hundred years. Three cowries, or two and your blanket.

06yyuz3.raw: 'In and out, faster every time. Three cowries. Don\'t block the exit.'
06yyuz3.text: In and out, faster every time. Three cowries. Don't block the exit.

1i5275u.raw: 'Sourced from the old pump. It hums when you turn it. Two cowries and a sandwich, the standard price for sandwiches.'
1i5275u.text: Sourced from the old pump. It hums when you turn it. Two cowries and a sandwich, the standard price for sandwiches.

156j34a.raw: 'It came from a buoy at the marsh mouth. It signals when something\'s wrong. Something\'s always wrong. Three cowries. It\'s going off now.'
156j34a.text: It came from a buoy at the marsh mouth. It signals when something's wrong. Something's always wrong. Three cowries. It's going off now.

0pu3l4p.raw: 'A wolf\'s cast, nose down, still on a smell from years back. It sniffs the four cowries before you can hand them over.'
0pu3l4p.text: A wolf's cast, nose down, still on a smell from years back. It sniffs the four cowries before you can hand them over.

0oin61u.raw: 'From an ox team. It drags whatever it\'s tied to. It won\'t stop even if you untie it. Three cowries, plus one fence.'
0oin61u.text: From an ox team. It drags whatever it's tied to. It won't stop even if you untie it. Three cowries, plus one fence.

0l5jym6.raw: 'A stoat in its winter fur. It slips through gaps a horn can\'t. Three cowries, if you can locate the hole it\'s hiding in.'
0l5jym6.text: A stoat in its winter fur. It slips through gaps a horn can't. Three cowries, if you can locate the hole it's hiding in.

0a1d11w.raw: 'Plus a leech. Clings until full. Then keeps clinging. Two cowries to start.'
0a1d11w.text: Plus a leech. Clings until full. Then keeps clinging. Two cowries to start.

0umje9z.raw: 'From the fence by the mill. It sits and waits. It has outlasted better company than yours. Three cowries. It will wait for those, too.'
0umje9z.text: From the fence by the mill. It sits and waits. It has outlasted better company than yours. Three cowries. It will wait for those, too.

1en8915.raw: 'A bull\'s cast. It lowers its head first, leaving you about a second to react. Four cowries, paid within that second.'
1en8915.text: A bull's cast. It lowers its head first, leaving you about a second to react. Four cowries, paid within that second.

1r3btm8.raw: 'A giant\'s thumb, detached. The rest of the giant either didn\'t shed or lost it elsewhere. Five cowries per thumb.'
1r3btm8.text: A giant's thumb, detached. The rest of the giant either didn't shed or lost it elsewhere. Five cowries per thumb.

1vfx4yw.raw: 'From a spring field. It boxes in spring. It boxes in autumn. It boxed me in summer, out of turn. Two cowries to whoever can contain it.'
1vfx4yw.text: From a spring field. It boxes in spring. It boxes in autumn. It boxed me in summer, out of turn. Two cowries to whoever can contain it.

01mjaag.raw: 'The moon leaves a thin shell behind each month, and they fall in the fields. One cowrie. Thirteen a year.'
01mjaag.text: The moon leaves a thin shell behind each month, and they fall in the fields. One cowrie. Thirteen a year.

18jktbq.raw: 'The head of a comet. It appears once in a lifetime, and here it is in my shop. Six cowries, for a once-in-a-lifetime event.'
18jktbq.text: The head of a comet. It appears once in a lifetime, and here it is in my shop. Six cowries, for a once-in-a-lifetime event.

042hord.raw: 'Plus a shell from a sky full of green light. It hangs over the north. Five cowries. It doesn\'t draw.'
042hord.text: Plus a shell from a sky full of green light. It hangs over the north. Five cowries. It doesn't draw.

11juzb3.raw: 'Beach glass where lightning struck. Strikes the same place twice. Four cowries. Twice.'
11juzb3.text: Beach glass where lightning struck. Strikes the same place twice. Four cowries. Twice.

0dfrln8.raw: 'From a saint still out walking, bareheaded. It floats over someone. Seven cowries, plus a hat for the saint.'
0dfrln8.text: From a saint still out walking, bareheaded. It floats over someone. Seven cowries, plus a hat for the saint.

13tvped.raw: 'The eclipse\'s shadow, fallen. It sweeps over at noon. Five cowries. Bring a lamp to count them by.'
13tvped.text: The eclipse's shadow, fallen. It sweeps over at noon. Five cowries. Bring a lamp to count them by.

1hyphv4.raw: 'And the shell of a red star, hanging in the sky before trouble arrives. No one agrees on what trouble. Four cowries. I say rain.'
1hyphv4.text: And the shell of a red star, hanging in the sky before trouble arrives. No one agrees on what trouble. Four cowries. I say rain.

1og0jnx.raw: 'Shed from the sun. It rises all at once. Six cowries and a bucket. A full bucket.'
1og0jnx.text: Shed from the sun. It rises all at once. Six cowries and a bucket. A full bucket.

1htpfv2.raw: 'Tack\'s cast. Not for sale. Tack would want to know who\'s asking, and how many times.'
1htpfv2.text: Tack's cast. Not for sale. Tack would want to know who's asking, and how many times.

0dlizt6.raw: 'The moon\'s first cast. No price. I wouldn\'t sell it to myself, despite having offered.'
0dlizt6.text: The moon's first cast. No price. I wouldn't sell it to myself, despite having offered.

0mrcl2m.raw: 'The old Volute\'s heart. No price. I don\'t have a slate big enough, and your grandmother\'s slate is very big.'
0mrcl2m.text: The old Volute's heart. No price. I don't have a slate big enough, and your grandmother's slate is very big.

0f8w62p.raw: 'The Holdfast\'s cast. No price. It was never for sale. Nor did it ever call for anything.'
0f8w62p.text: The Holdfast's cast. No price. It was never for sale. Nor did it ever call for anything.

0lx47cr.raw: 'From a turtle, an island. No price. I\'d need a slate that floats.'
0lx47cr.text: From a turtle, an island. No price. I'd need a slate that floats.

1uc0nip.raw: 'Plus a dandelion gone to seed. It plants seeds in whoever it argues with. Two cowries. It\'s arguing with me now.'
1uc0nip.text: Plus a dandelion gone to seed. It plants seeds in whoever it argues with. Two cowries. It's arguing with me now.

1r7lvwb.raw: 'A scarecrow\'s casing, from March. Crows still avoid landing near it. Two cowries, or one courageous crow.'
1r7lvwb.text: A scarecrow's casing, from March. Crows still avoid landing near it. Two cowries, or one courageous crow.

1j9695e.raw: 'From a farrier\'s kit. Six blades, no handle. It leaves one in you. Three cowries for however many it has left.'
1j9695e.text: From a farrier's kit. Six blades, no handle. It leaves one in you. Three cowries for however many it has left.

1o9fbz4.raw: 'Plus a curing vat that walked off half full. What\'s inside is still curing. Three cowries for the vat. I wouldn\'t price what\'s inside.'
1o9fbz4.text: Plus a curing vat that walked off half full. What's inside is still curing. Three cowries for the vat. I wouldn't price what's inside.

0gbmubw.raw: 'From a hay cart. It starts slow and doesn\'t stop. It went through the grotto wall once. Four cowries, plus the wall.'
0gbmubw.text: From a hay cart. It starts slow and doesn't stop. It went through the grotto wall once. Four cowries, plus the wall.

1s31mjb.raw: 'A mole\'s shell, pink star on the nose. It comes up under you and goes back down. Two cowries, paid underground.'
1s31mjb.text: A mole's shell, pink star on the nose. It comes up under you and goes back down. Two cowries, paid underground.

18mxndl.raw: 'From a root cellar in Turnstone. Hit it when it\'s nearly empty and it fills back up. Four cowries. The jam\'s gone.'
18mxndl.text: From a root cellar in Turnstone. Hit it when it's nearly empty and it fills back up. Four cowries. The jam's gone.

0180h3d.raw: 'A lugworm shell on the sand has a face at each end. Split it. Both halves return. Each half is one cowrie. How many are in play?'
0180h3d.text: A lugworm shell on the sand has a face at each end. Split it. Both halves return. Each half is one cowrie. How many are in play?

1agqjrg.raw: 'A hobnailed boot that nobody wears. It keeps every nail it drives into you. Three cowries. Left foot only.'
1agqjrg.text: A hobnailed boot that nobody wears. It keeps every nail it drives into you. Three cowries. Left foot only.

067g3m9.raw: 'A beach pea pod, sized like a cat. The peas stare back. It sprouts more pods and kicks them away. Two cowries per pod.'
067g3m9.text: A beach pea pod, sized like a cat. The peas stare back. It sprouts more pods and kicks them away. Two cowries per pod.

14pylvu.raw: 'A cellar door with an eye where the handle should be. What it traps inside eventually returns. Five cowries. Knock first.'
14pylvu.text: A cellar door with an eye where the handle should be. What it traps inside eventually returns. Five cowries. Knock first.

0dtrcsm.raw: 'A cave cricket with its knees bent backward. It chirps three times, softly. Three cowries, one per chirp.'
0dtrcsm.text: A cave cricket with its knees bent backward. It chirps three times, softly. Three cowries, one per chirp.

050kb5w.raw: 'A giant\'s knucklebone from the Knucklebones. It\'s hollow, with a mouth over its eyes. Throw it, and it lands twice. Two cowries.'
050kb5w.text: A giant's knucklebone from the Knucklebones. It's hollow, with a mouth over its eyes. Throw it, and it lands twice. Two cowries.

1lymktp.raw: 'A giant\'s back tooth, hollow as a whelk shell. It peers out from its roots. It grows on whatever it chews. Four cowries. Do not bite.'
1lymktp.text: A giant's back tooth, hollow as a whelk shell. It peers out from its roots. It grows on whatever it chews. Four cowries. Do not bite.

0izmdf5.raw: 'The top bone of a giant\'s neck. It held a head upright for three hundred years. Now it holds a grudge. It demands four cowries as well.'
0izmdf5.text: The top bone of a giant's neck. It held a head upright for three hundred years. Now it holds a grudge. It demands four cowries as well.

0bh5ctu.raw: 'A giant\'s fingernail. It scratches the same spot until the skin gives way. Three cowries. Unfiled.'
0bh5ctu.text: A giant's fingernail. It scratches the same spot until the skin gives way. Three cowries. Unfiled.

0anljc8.raw: 'The ball and socket of a giant\'s hip. The head never sits level. It leans heavily to one side or the other. Three cowries. Mine leans left.'
0anljc8.text: The ball and socket of a giant's hip. The head never sits level. It leans heavily to one side or the other. Three cowries. Mine leans left.

00h1aha.raw: 'A wishbone from a bird larger than a barn. It pulls long, then short, then long again. Five cowries. I wished for six.'
00h1aha.text: A wishbone from a bird larger than a barn. It pulls long, then short, then long again. Five cowries. I wished for six.

1m9bswd.raw: 'An urchin\'s test from the dry sea floor, with its mouth underneath. Whatever sticks to it falls off. Two cowries. Unsticky.'
1m9bswd.text: An urchin's test from the dry sea floor, with its mouth underneath. Whatever sticks to it falls off. Two cowries. Unsticky.

0hetdqw.raw: 'A fiddler crab with one claw larger than the rest. Strike the claw, and it strikes back. Three cowries. The claw is extra.'
0hetdqw.text: A fiddler crab with one claw larger than the rest. Strike the claw, and it strikes back. Three cowries. The claw is extra.

0jfuduu.raw: 'The water hovering over the dry sea, standing on its own reflection. Stones pass right through it. Four cowries. See-through.'
0jfuduu.text: The water hovering over the dry sea, standing on its own reflection. Stones pass right through it. Four cowries. See-through.

0w7t68e.raw: 'An anchor from the Wrecks, walking on its flukes. It marks a spot and returns you to it. You will come back. Bring five cowries.'
0w7t68e.text: An anchor from the Wrecks, walking on its flukes. It marks a spot and returns you to it. You will come back. Bring five cowries.

0zkyz61.raw: 'A figurehead that left before the ship sank. It still stands in front of people. Pass the five cowries around it.'
0zkyz61.text: A figurehead that left before the ship sank. It still stands in front of people. Pass the five cowries around it.

0ci22gg.raw: 'A bilge pump with no ship left to bail. It pumps your tide out instead. Three cowries. The bilge boy wants it back.'
0ci22gg.text: A bilge pump with no ship left to bail. It pumps your tide out instead. Three cowries. The bilge boy wants it back.

0swifeh.raw: 'Torn sail, mast in face. Tacks in no wind. Two cowries. I\'ve tried blowing.'
0swifeh.text: Torn sail, mast in face. Tacks in no wind. Two cowries. I've tried blowing.

00nezc7.raw: 'Still after forty years, keel off the dry sea. Moves others far. Five cowries, no delivery.'
00nezc7.text: Still after forty years, keel off the dry sea. Moves others far. Five cowries, no delivery.

0r2a7py.raw: 'Ship\'s cannon talks through its head. Shot lands where you will be by then. Four cowries, plus ducking.'
0r2a7py.text: Ship's cannon talks through its head. Shot lands where you will be by then. Four cowries, plus ducking.

1be3pmb.raw: 'Wave breaks off gray wall, one eye in curl. Drags till hit. Four cowries, wet.'
1be3pmb.text: Wave breaks off gray wall, one eye in curl. Drags till hit. Four cowries, wet.

0ch7b4g.raw: 'Skua with second beak in belly. Follows yours, paid when it drops. Three cowries. Same trade.'
0ch7b4g.text: Skua with second beak in belly. Follows yours, paid when it drops. Three cowries. Same trade.

0355rby.raw: 'A bloom of jellyfish off the shoreline. It stings anything nearby and burns through your tide to do it. Three cowries. Ouch.'
0355rby.text: A bloom of jellyfish off the shoreline. It stings anything nearby and burns through your tide to do it. Three cowries. Ouch.

1oyuhqs.raw: 'Driftwood off gray wall, face on cut end. Grows bark on friends. Two cowries, salted. Unsalted costs more.'
1oyuhqs.text: Driftwood off gray wall, face on cut end. Grows bark on friends. Two cowries, salted. Unsalted costs more.

1uvxtc9.raw: 'Sea foam released by the gray wall. You hit what it holds. The foam keeps the bill. The bill comes. Four cowries, I respect it.'
1uvxtc9.text: Sea foam released by the gray wall. You hit what it holds. The foam keeps the bill. The bill comes. Four cowries, I respect it.

0a4rtvp.raw: 'A fragment of the sea\'s own shell, found by the wall at dusk. The sea demands its return. Seven cowries. The sea hasn\'t made an offer yet.'
0a4rtvp.text: A fragment of the sea's own shell, found by the wall at dusk. The sea demands its return. Seven cowries. The sea hasn't made an offer yet.

0hsioe8.raw: 'Heron on one leg, aiming. Longer it stands, worse for you. Three cowries. Aimed at me all week.'
0hsioe8.text: Heron on one leg, aiming. Longer it stands, worse for you. Three cowries. Aimed at me all week.

0zsbeql.raw: 'Plus a glass eel. You can see its recent meal. Every third bite refuses to let go. Two cowries, plus the cost of whatever it consumed.'
0zsbeql.text: Plus a glass eel. You can see its recent meal. Every third bite refuses to let go. Two cowries, plus the cost of whatever it consumed.

0uuqpq5.raw: 'A slice of peat from the marsh, facing upward from its top. It retains whatever falls inside. Three cowries per brick. I lost a spoon.'
0uuqpq5.text: A slice of peat from the marsh, facing upward from its top. It retains whatever falls inside. Three cowries per brick. I lost a spoon.

1sh25ql.raw: 'Tenor bell under Spire, hopping on clapper. Rings, front stays put. Six cowries. Goes last.'
1sh25ql.text: Tenor bell under Spire, hopping on clapper. Rings, front stays put. Six cowries. Goes last.

1kfsrbh.raw: 'A fractured window from beneath the Spire, with an eye in each pane. Each pane absorbs one impact. Five cowries, charged per pane.'
1kfsrbh.text: A fractured window from beneath the Spire, with an eye in each pane. Each pane absorbs one impact. Five cowries, charged per pane.

0gbkkpa.raw: 'Sings from middle, an organ pipe. Notes hit people after it stops. Four cowries, plus earplugs.'
0gbkkpa.text: Sings from middle, an organ pipe. Notes hit people after it stops. Four cowries, plus earplugs.

1b92e1p.raw: 'A pew from beneath the Spire, with a face in the backrest. While it sits, no one nearby falls completely. Four cowries, seated.'
1b92e1p.text: A pew from beneath the Spire, with a face in the backrest. While it sits, no one nearby falls completely. Four cowries, seated.

07bd3ex.raw: 'A reliquary with one eye watching through the glass. Whatever it puts down, it keeps a piece of. Six cowries. It kept my change.'
07bd3ex.text: A reliquary with one eye watching through the glass. Whatever it puts down, it keeps a piece of. Six cowries. It kept my change.

0geb7nd.raw: 'Spire\'s censer smokes at the ears. Smoke hits you two breaths later. Pay five cowries between breaths.'
0geb7nd.text: Spire's censer smokes at the ears. Smoke hits you two breaths later. Pay five cowries between breaths.

1h5fb09.raw: 'An owl with extra eyes on its wings. It silences all it sees. I\'d quote a price, but it\'s watching. Four cowries.'
1h5fb09.text: An owl with extra eyes on its wings. It silences all it sees. I'd quote a price, but it's watching. Four cowries.

0rpfj6o.raw: 'A stag\'s shell, antlers attached. It collects everything you strike it with. Five cowries. It\'s collecting them, too.'
0rpfj6o.text: A stag's shell, antlers attached. It collects everything you strike it with. Five cowries. It's collecting them, too.

1rtfw9f.raw: 'A straw beehive abandoned by its bees. It stings on its own, through the opening in its belly. Two cowries and gloves. My gloves.'
1rtfw9f.text: A straw beehive abandoned by its bees. It stings on its own, through the opening in its belly. Two cowries and gloves. My gloves.

0jcp1nm.raw: 'A taproot from the Bole, walking on its leaves. It anchors things in place and drinks from them. Three cowries and a drink.'
0jcp1nm.text: A taproot from the Bole, walking on its leaves. It anchors things in place and drinks from them. Three cowries and a drink.

03fktke.raw: 'A bark beetle bored all the way through. It waits in its own holes and hits you on the way out. Two cowries. Holes free.'
03fktke.text: A bark beetle bored all the way through. It waits in its own holes and hits you on the way out. Two cowries. Holes free.

0dcchh5.raw: 'Plus the clump of earth from beneath the Bole\'s roots. A small lump trails behind it. One cowrie. The lump is free. It insists on following.'
0dcchh5.text: Plus the clump of earth from beneath the Bole's roots. A small lump trails behind it. One cowrie. The lump is free. It insists on following.

1q7jyxf.raw: 'A sapling from the Rootfall, face hidden in the leaves. It holds onto anything that harms its friends. Three cowries. Befriend it.'
1q7jyxf.text: A sapling from the Rootfall, face hidden in the leaves. It holds onto anything that harms its friends. Three cowries. Befriend it.

1wca6nh.raw: 'A face from Bole\'s roots, one eye too big. Gaze at it to sleep. Wakers fall asleep too. Six cowries if you\'re awake.'
1wca6nh.text: A face from Bole's roots, one eye too big. Gaze at it to sleep. Wakers fall asleep too. Six cowries if you're awake.

0ek57lp.raw: 'Rain that fell upward near the Bole and kept doing so. It makes friends taller and enemies shorter. Three cowries. Ask the Upright Man.'
0ek57lp.text: Rain that fell upward near the Bole and kept doing so. It makes friends taller and enemies shorter. Three cowries. Ask the Upright Man.

0zmmcz0.raw: 'A brick kiln from the old works. One side remains warm. Hand it a notion and it hands it back harder. Four cowries, warm side up.'
0zmmcz0.text: A brick kiln from the old works. One side remains warm. Hand it a notion and it hands it back harder. Four cowries, warm side up.

0qok6fv.raw: 'It carries whatever stands on it to the same place, at the same speed. A conveyor belt\'s shell. Three cowries, same price.'
0qok6fv.text: It carries whatever stands on it to the same place, at the same speed. A conveyor belt's shell. Three cowries, same price.

0ah2txk.raw: 'From the Rim\'s old mast, a monk-like vigil. It hums unknown signals, passing them on. Four cowries for quiet.'
0ah2txk.text: From the Rim's old mast, a monk-like vigil. It hums unknown signals, passing them on. Four cowries for quiet.

0le8gf6.raw: 'A sail with nothing left to push it. It comes down beside things about to tip over. Five cowries. I\'m standing well back.'
0le8gf6.text: A sail with nothing left to push it. It comes down beside things about to tip over. Five cowries. I'm standing well back.

0bdkxa9.raw: 'Heated from high above, shut tight like a clam. It opens for a friend and closes behind them. Four cowries. I\'m not its friend.'
0bdkxa9.text: Heated from high above, shut tight like a clam. It opens for a friend and closes behind them. Four cowries. I'm not its friend.

1yi305u.raw: 'The piece that detaches first. Now it leaves things intentionally. Keep it off the roof. Three cowries. You cover the roof.'
1yi305u.text: The piece that detaches first. Now it leaves things intentionally. Keep it off the roof. Three cowries. You cover the roof.

0p6raqp.raw: 'From the Dropfield. It points its face at whoever spoke last and repeats it louder. Five cowries. FIVE COWRIES.'
0p6raqp.text: From the Dropfield. It points its face at whoever spoke last and repeats it louder. Five cowries. FIVE COWRIES.

0lujbf6.raw: 'Hull scrap fused into a single lump, one eye larger than the other. It runs hot and needs to sit down. Three cowries. I know the feeling.'
0lujbf6.text: Hull scrap fused into a single lump, one eye larger than the other. It runs hot and needs to sit down. Three cowries. I know the feeling.

00fi6jo.raw: 'A musk ox\'s cast, left standing in the snow. Eyes down by its knees. Frost on whatever it looks at. I ask four cowries, from behind it.'
00fi6jo.text: A musk ox's cast, left standing in the snow. Eyes down by its knees. Frost on whatever it looks at. I ask four cowries, from behind it.

0t9elsf.raw: 'Plus a block that walked off the glacier. Stand still near it and your boots freeze to the ground. Pay the four cowries while you\'re moving.'
0t9elsf.text: Plus a block that walked off the glacier. Stand still near it and your boots freeze to the ground. Pay the four cowries while you're moving.

0bv3hdk.raw: 'What a seal-woman left on the ice. Someone hid it in a chest once. It sleeps wherever it likes now. Five cowries. Don\'t tell her husband.'
0bv3hdk.text: What a seal-woman left on the ice. Someone hid it in a chest once. It sleeps wherever it likes now. Five cowries. Don't tell her husband.

1wke9pd.raw: 'Tusks growing upward instead of downward. Every third punch it throws is the one people talk about. Three cowries. People talk.'
1wke9pd.text: Tusks growing upward instead of downward. Every third punch it throws is the one people talk about. Three cowries. People talk.

13d3h21.raw: 'From the shelf. Most of it is under the ice, face included. Five cowries for the top. The rest costs extra.'
13d3h21.text: From the shelf. Most of it is under the ice, face included. Five cowries for the top. The rest costs extra.

1g6kftc.raw: 'Which waits beneath the shelf, lining its tusk up at you. The longer it waits, the worse it gets. Four cowries, before it lines up.'
1g6kftc.text: Which waits beneath the shelf, lining its tusk up at you. The longer it waits, the worse it gets. Four cowries, before it lines up.

1ud6fan.raw: 'An icicle fell from the eaves, in love with the resident, and gained life for them. Three cowries. It still melts slightly when they pass.'
1ud6fan.text: An icicle fell from the eaves, in love with the resident, and gained life for them. Three cowries. It still melts slightly when they pass.

1ht2vda.raw: 'From the last pair of great auks, gone in my grandfather\'s time. Their shells kept going. Six cowries, and I\'d rather you kept it.'
1ht2vda.text: From the last pair of great auks, gone in my grandfather's time. Their shells kept going. Six cowries, and I'd rather you kept it.

0bgsjhj.raw: 'A soldier\'s breastplate from the Hilt road. A face where the heart was. Each dent hardens it and makes it dearer. Four cowries.'
0bgsjhj.text: A soldier's breastplate from the Hilt road. A face where the heart was. Each dent hardens it and makes it dearer. Four cowries.

06e87t0.raw: 'And a battle banner, with the pole as a backbone. It snaps once before it does anything. Hand it three cowries and it snaps at those too.'
06e87t0.text: And a battle banner, with the pole as a backbone. It snaps once before it does anything. Hand it three cowries and it snaps at those too.

06p9z4v.raw: 'The half of a sword that stays in the grip. It spins when it\'s cornered. Five cowries for half a sword. The other half is more expensive.'
06p9z4v.text: The half of a sword that stays in the grip. It spins when it's cornered. Five cowries for half a sword. The other half is more expensive.

0phce6w.raw: 'A round shield, with one eye where the boss should be. It counts the blows it takes and pays each one back. Four cowries. Honest, that.'
0phce6w.text: A round shield, with one eye where the boss should be. It counts the blows it takes and pays each one back. Four cowries. Honest, that.

0262toj.raw: 'Plus a war horse with the barding still on. Throw it and it gets up and climbs back onto itself. Five cowries and a brush.'
0262toj.text: Plus a war horse with the barding still on. Throw it and it gets up and climbs back onto itself. Five cowries and a brush.

03y03sl.raw: 'A head-catapult throws caught items, growing larger. Costs five cowries. Stand behind it to pay.'
03y03sl.text: A head-catapult throws caught items, growing larger. Costs five cowries. Stand behind it to pay.

1jhotho.raw: 'A battlefield helmet on two short legs. Some days, a drake hides inside. Five cowries, though the price rises on drake days.'
1jhotho.text: A battlefield helmet on two short legs. Some days, a drake hides inside. Five cowries, though the price rises on drake days.

1trtgpd.raw: 'An arrow that never fell. It rests in the quiver and emerges sharper. Four cowries. Someone is still waiting beneath it.'
1trtgpd.text: An arrow that never fell. It rests in the quiver and emerges sharper. Four cowries. Someone is still waiting beneath it.

1fjqsfi.raw: 'A moonlit lakebed reflection. It mimics your next move. Costs six cowries. You were about to pay.'
1fjqsfi.text: A moonlit lakebed reflection. It mimics your next move. Costs six cowries. You were about to pay.

1560w4v.raw: 'A mudskipper that hops whenever you look at it. Something larger follows it through the mud. Three cowries, and I won\'t ask what it is.'
1560w4v.text: A mudskipper that hops whenever you look at it. Something larger follows it through the mud. Three cowries, and I won't ask what it is.

0nljnix.raw: 'Moonwater silt eyes at the bottom. Wade to your ankles and stop. I ask three cowries from dry land.'
0nljnix.text: Moonwater silt eyes at the bottom. Wade to your ankles and stop. I ask three cowries from dry land.

1qsinym.raw: 'A frog with its mouth on its belly. It temporarily turns other creatures into frogs. Three cowries. I was a frog on Tuesday.'
1qsinym.text: A frog with its mouth on its belly. It temporarily turns other creatures into frogs. Three cowries. I was a frog on Tuesday.

0yxo9eh.raw: 'A fragment of the moon\'s shell, broken during its ascent. It throws its edges about, and they return. Six cowries. Mine did not.'
0yxo9eh.text: A fragment of the moon's shell, broken during its ascent. It throws its edges about, and they return. Six cowries. Mine did not.

043oqbp.raw: 'An iron stone from a fallen star. If you walk past it, your buckles attempt to stay put. Five cowries, plus whatever buckles it retains.'
043oqbp.text: An iron stone from a fallen star. If you walk past it, your buckles attempt to stay put. Five cowries, plus whatever buckles it retains.

0wsnl1t.raw: 'Furnace slag with a brew fermenting inside. Sell it before the brew spoils. Four cowries. I am selling it on.'
0wsnl1t.text: Furnace slag with a brew fermenting inside. Sell it before the brew spoils. Four cowries. I am selling it on.

09w9e6g.raw: 'Broken glass desert debris. It holds its grip until you both cease. Five cowries, paid in gloves.'
09w9e6g.text: Broken glass desert debris. It holds its grip until you both cease. Five cowries, paid in gloves.

1uzme8v.raw: 'The tail end of a scorpion. It walks on its sting, keeping the rest of its body aloft. Five cowries. Do not shake hands on the deal.'
1uzme8v.text: The tail end of a scorpion. It walks on its sting, keeping the rest of its body aloft. Five cowries. Do not shake hands on the deal.

1v6xgd0.raw: 'A jumping cactus. It does indeed jump. Pull out one joint, and another is already in place. Four cowries, which it jumped at.'
1v6xgd0.text: A jumping cactus. It does indeed jump. Pull out one joint, and another is already in place. Four cowries, which it jumped at.

0ntlgxu.raw: 'A dune containing a dead reef. It rises on the road at night and halts at the door. It buds smaller versions. Four cowries, and two shovels.'
0ntlgxu.text: A dune containing a dead reef. It rises on the road at night and halts at the door. It buds smaller versions. Four cowries, and two shovels.

1wqxrvo.raw: 'A wobble of hot glass, left behind. It keeps three weathers in its mouth and mixes them. Six cowries. Mixing is free.'
1wqxrvo.text: A wobble of hot glass, left behind. It keeps three weathers in its mouth and mixes them. Six cowries. Mixing is free.

1tfgoyt.raw: 'A desert skull, bleached white as nacre. It rises once more than you might expect. Five cowries. Then once more.'
1tfgoyt.text: A desert skull, bleached white as nacre. It rises once more than you might expect. Five cowries. Then once more.

1sqerfy.raw: 'From the Hands\' orchard, shears pick one branch and cut only that one. Six cowries. Tidy.'
1sqerfy.text: From the Hands' orchard, shears pick one branch and cut only that one. Six cowries. Tidy.

0w34kvu.raw: 'A gardener\'s glove, face in the palm. It hurls itself at a companion, who then lands swinging. Five cowries. No pairs.'
0w34kvu.text: A gardener's glove, face in the palm. It hurls itself at a companion, who then lands swinging. Five cowries. No pairs.

1d66zp4.raw: 'A grafted branch, inheriting traits from whichever tree it strikes first. Six cowries. Grafton would charge seven.'
1d66zp4.text: A grafted branch, inheriting traits from whichever tree it strikes first. Six cowries. Grafton would charge seven.

0kgqa6o.raw: 'A flat pear tree on the wall feeds leaners. Six cowries, pears included.'
0kgqa6o.text: A flat pear tree on the wall feeds leaners. Six cowries, pears included.

0u3ihwt.raw: 'A rung from a ladder on the Climb. With every turn it takes, it climbs higher. Six cowries for the bottom step.'
0u3ihwt.text: A rung from a ladder on the Climb. With every turn it takes, it climbs higher. Six cowries for the bottom step.

1ypzmca.raw: 'A blank space at the edge where nothing existed. Strike it, and everyone present feels the impact. Seven cowries for nothing. A bargain.'
1ypzmca.text: A blank space at the edge where nothing existed. Strike it, and everyone present feels the impact. Seven cowries for nothing. A bargain.

1rdyib1.raw: 'The end of a road. Anything that reaches it stays put. It charges the barrier. Seven cowries, and that is the final cost.'
1rdyib1.text: The end of a road. Anything that reaches it stays put. It charges the barrier. Seven cowries, and that is the final cost.

1dtpyth.raw: 'This horizon, which still has its stars revolving around it. They fall when it commands. Seven cowries. It never asks me.'
1dtpyth.text: This horizon, which still has its stars revolving around it. They fall when it commands. Seven cowries. It never asks me.

1rft97a.raw: 'At the tide\'s edge, the fog cuts deepest at those who haven\'t touched it yet. Seven cowries. Touch it first.'
1rft97a.text: At the tide's edge, the fog cuts deepest at those who haven't touched it yet. Seven cowries. Touch it first.

00welkc.raw: 'Beyond the edge lies something drowned. This is the part that fits in the Register. Seven cowries for this part. Rest on request.'
00welkc.text: Beyond the edge lies something drowned. This is the part that fits in the Register. Seven cowries for this part. Rest on request.

19eagaw.raw: 'A piece of the Rim that walked away. It pulls things over the edge and grows heavier. Seven cowries, charged by weight. Today\'s weight.'
19eagaw.text: A piece of the Rim that walked away. It pulls things over the edge and grows heavier. Seven cowries, charged by weight. Today's weight.

1uxs6w1.raw: 'From the Shallows, a wrinkle in the loose ground. Step on one corner, and the others rise. Six cowries. I would iron it out.'
1uxs6w1.text: From the Shallows, a wrinkle in the loose ground. Step on one corner, and the others rise. Six cowries. I would iron it out.

0hfg4ih.raw: 'A dip in the Shallows that fills with saltwater rising from below. It lays down mud in layers and wears them away. Six cowries, muddy.'
0hfg4ih.text: A dip in the Shallows that fills with saltwater rising from below. It lays down mud in layers and wears them away. Six cowries, muddy.

1y6mhpk.raw: 'A fracture that rose from the ground and walked away. It sets a ring of thorns on anyone who follows. Seven cowries. Walk beside it.'
1y6mhpk.text: A fracture that rose from the ground and walked away. It sets a ring of thorns on anyone who follows. Seven cowries. Walk beside it.

14m9v7w.raw: 'Off the Volute\'s outer curve, a barnacle. It lived its entire life on your world, never once glancing inward. Two cowries.'
14m9v7w.text: Off the Volute's outer curve, a barnacle. It lived its entire life on your world, never once glancing inward. Two cowries.

04k32m7.raw: 'It was the lip of the Volute, until one spring the shell outgrew it. So it packed up and left. Three cowries. It still believes it\'s a lip.'
04k32m7.text: It was the lip of the Volute, until one spring the shell outgrew it. So it packed up and left. Three cowries. It still believes it's a lip.

04q10p0.raw: 'Gull. Forty years it rode the Volute\'s air each dusk. Still rises at six, even indoors. Two cowries. Ceiling extra.'
04q10p0.text: Gull. Forty years it rode the Volute's air each dusk. Still rises at six, even indoors. Two cowries. Ceiling extra.

1cc3a7y.raw: 'Spray, dried onto the Volute\'s exterior, square in every grain. I counted them all. Two cowries, plus a week\'s wage for the counting.'
1cc3a7y.text: Spray, dried onto the Volute's exterior, square in every grain. I counted them all. Two cowries, plus a week's wage for the counting.

1xtqb9i.raw: 'A sand hopper, dog-sized. It jumps at shadows and lands on them, so keep yours perfectly still. One cowrie. My shadow is still bruised.'
1xtqb9i.text: A sand hopper, dog-sized. It jumps at shadows and lands on them, so keep yours perfectly still. One cowrie. My shadow is still bruised.

16hpvgp.raw: 'Wrack weed off the tide line. Kids buy it for the pop. One cowrie. Won\'t pop for anyone who\'s shed.'
16hpvgp.text: Wrack weed off the tide line. Kids buy it for the pop. One cowrie. Won't pop for anyone who's shed.

1a98e3b.raw: 'A crate floated in, shut tight. I offered well for its contents, but it refused to open. Rude. Three cowries, contents unknown.'
1a98e3b.text: A crate floated in, shut tight. I offered well for its contents, but it refused to open. Rude. Three cowries, contents unknown.

1vg8e1v.raw: 'A fallen star, a grain the size of a fist. Warm on one side, and that side keeps rotating. Four cowries. Bring tongs.'
1vg8e1v.text: A fallen star, a grain the size of a fist. Warm on one side, and that side keeps rotating. Four cowries. Bring tongs.

03o9yle.raw: 'Plus a bottle. It broke on the wrack, got frosted by salt, then walked away. Two cowries. The sharp end is the front, so hold the back.'
03o9yle.text: Plus a bottle. It broke on the wrack, got frosted by salt, then walked away. Two cowries. The sharp end is the front, so hold the back.

16yyay8.raw: 'Fish, dried and salted on the wrack line by no one. Who salts a fish for no one? Very dry. One cowrie, which is more than no one charged.'
16yyay8.text: Fish, dried and salted on the wrack line by no one. Who salts a fish for no one? Very dry. One cowrie, which is more than no one charged.

0xkzq9l.raw: 'Tide-pool flower. Closes at any shadow, which is always. Closed now. Two cowries, sold shut.'
0xkzq9l.text: Tide-pool flower. Closes at any shadow, which is always. Closed now. Two cowries, sold shut.

0u1y65n.raw: 'Sand hollow where a taken shell lay. It searches for it, hasn\'t found it. Three cowries. It checks pockets.'
0u1y65n.text: Sand hollow where a taken shell lay. It searches for it, hasn't found it. Three cowries. It checks pockets.

1p1hz5m.raw: 'One of the five doves from a sand dollar. It flies only at night and brings things back. Four cowries, or whatever it brought you.'
1p1hz5m.text: One of the five doves from a sand dollar. It flies only at night and brings things back. Four cowries, or whatever it brought you.

0xo6cdd.raw: 'And the curl of sand a worm pushes up at low water. The worm is gone. The curl keeps curling. One cowrie. The worm is extra, if found.'
0xo6cdd.text: And the curl of sand a worm pushes up at low water. The worm is gone. The curl keeps curling. One cowrie. The worm is extra, if found.

1004sra.raw: 'Razor clam. It digs straight down whenever a star lands nearby, which is every night here. Three cowries, if you can dig it up.'
1004sra.text: Razor clam. It digs straight down whenever a star lands nearby, which is every night here. Three cowries, if you can dig it up.

1ts9vef.raw: 'The ring of light a landed star leaves on wet sand! This one has never faded. Five cowries. You won\'t sleep with it in the room.'
1ts9vef.text: The ring of light a landed star leaves on wet sand! This one has never faded. Five cowries. You won't sleep with it in the room.

19gznoe.raw: 'A dark smudge on the Cowrie\'s dome. It shifts when you aren\'t watching. I\'ve never caught it moving, so I trust it. Three cowries.'
19gznoe.text: A dark smudge on the Cowrie's dome. It shifts when you aren't watching. I've never caught it moving, so I trust it. Three cowries.

0wrua57.raw: 'The soft sheath a cowrie slides over its shell. It polishes whatever surface it rests on. Three slippery cowries.'
0wrua57.text: The soft sheath a cowrie slides over its shell. It polishes whatever surface it rests on. Three slippery cowries.

1l0jxni.raw: 'Wave. Gray, standing on sand since my grandfather. Won\'t budge. Four cowries.'
1l0jxni.text: Wave. Gray, standing on sand since my grandfather. Won't budge. Four cowries.

1k1muiy.raw: 'Sea spray blown from a wave. The wave has stopped, but the spray hasn\'t. Two cowries, paid in haste.'
1k1muiy.text: Sea spray blown from a wave. The wave has stopped, but the spray hasn't. Two cowries, paid in haste.

19310uo.raw: 'The top layer of the Cowrie\'s polish, peeled off in one sheet and left standing. Three cowries. It reveals every fingerprint.'
19310uo.text: The top layer of the Cowrie's polish, peeled off in one sheet and left standing. Three cowries. It reveals every fingerprint.

19s2boz.raw: 'Pig! Small, round, glazed, kept by the Cowrie folk. Rolls when the floor tilts, which it does. Two cowries. You chase it.'
19s2boz.text: Pig! Small, round, glazed, kept by the Cowrie folk. Rolls when the floor tilts, which it does. Two cowries. You chase it.

0ujk8v5.raw: 'Cowrie purse that shut up. Clinks when happy. Counting money hurts. Five cowries, or one of itself.'
0ujk8v5.text: Cowrie purse that shut up. Clinks when happy. Counting money hurts. Five cowries, or one of itself.

13h7w8q.raw: 'The grit the Cowrie folk use for polishing. It scrubs anything that touches it, including hands. Two cowries. Pay with your other hand.'
13h7w8q.text: The grit the Cowrie folk use for polishing. It scrubs anything that touches it, including hands. Two cowries. Pay with your other hand.

0rums0z.raw: 'Glazed flower from a Cowrie box. Rings when touched. Ting! That\'s me. Three cowries/flower.'
0rums0z.text: Glazed flower from a Cowrie box. Rings when touched. Ting! That's me. Three cowries/flower.

044c67s.raw: 'Three Cowrie teeth meshing on air. They\'ll mesh on you. Roll up sleeves. Hand me two cowries.'
044c67s.text: Three Cowrie teeth meshing on air. They'll mesh on you. Roll up sleeves. Hand me two cowries.

1vo9iwy.raw: 'The gap between two of the Cowrie\'s teeth. It wandered off, and the teeth snapped shut behind it. Four cowries, which is a lot for a gap.'
1vo9iwy.text: The gap between two of the Cowrie's teeth. It wandered off, and the teeth snapped shut behind it. Four cowries, which is a lot for a gap.

02wibab.raw: 'Plus the rolled edge of the Cowrie\'s lip. It keeps rolling inward. It comes out fast. Two cowries, faster than you.'
02wibab.text: Plus the rolled edge of the Cowrie's lip. It keeps rolling inward. It comes out fast. Two cowries, faster than you.

134td8h.raw: 'A reflection. It fell three steps behind its owner and never caught up. It mimics your movements. Four cowries, paid three steps ago.'
134td8h.text: A reflection. It fell three steps behind its owner and never caught up. It mimics your movements. Four cowries, paid three steps ago.

1qpqc2w.raw: 'The back of a mirror, the silver backing. It shows nothing on its own. Hold it up to me, and it reveals three cowries.'
1qpqc2w.text: The back of a mirror, the silver backing. It shows nothing on its own. Hold it up to me, and it reveals three cowries.

0hwhehc.raw: 'Glow from the Cowrie\'s dome in total darkness. It wandered off on its own one night. Four cowries. It outshines your lamp out of spite.'
0hwhehc.text: Glow from the Cowrie's dome in total darkness. It wandered off on its own one night. Four cowries. It outshines your lamp out of spite.

08mxyls.raw: 'Plus wind. It spun inside the Auger so long it took on its shape. Sit down before you count out three cowries.'
08mxyls.text: Plus wind. It spun inside the Auger so long it took on its shape. Sit down before you count out three cowries.

0grctbf.raw: 'Lichen, found on the Auger\'s exterior. It migrates to the dry side with every tide. Is it slow? Extremely. One cowrie, payable next year.'
0grctbf.text: Lichen, found on the Auger's exterior. It migrates to the dry side with every tide. Is it slow? Extremely. One cowrie, payable next year.

0201y44.raw: 'The swell that raised the Auger at high water and set it down again lifts cargo, and prices too. Three cowries this morning. Four now.'
0201y44.text: The swell that raised the Auger at high water and set it down again lifts cargo, and prices too. Three cowries this morning. Four now.

1fsiqih.raw: 'White dust, once kept in a climber\'s pouch until it escaped. Two cowries, and it will escape from yours as well.'
1fsiqih.text: White dust, once kept in a climber's pouch until it escaped. Two cowries, and it will escape from yours as well.

17txjpt.raw: 'The white line the tide leaves on the Auger\'s walls, rising slightly with each wave. Three cowries and climbing.'
17txjpt.text: The white line the tide leaves on the Auger's walls, rising slightly with each wave. Three cowries and climbing.

00z0acs.raw: 'Weed. It rolls through the Auger\'s rooms but never takes root. It entered my front door and exited the back without paying. One cowrie.'
00z0acs.text: Weed. It rolls through the Auger's rooms but never takes root. It entered my front door and exited the back without paying. One cowrie.

1q4wq9d.raw: 'One step off the Auger\'s staircase. Stand on it, and it rises on its own. Three cowries, ascending.'
1q4wq9d.text: One step off the Auger's staircase. Stand on it, and it rises on its own. Three cowries, ascending.

11pvsml.raw: 'The central post of the Auger. It climbed itself! Everything leans against it, including me. Five cowries, and it leans back.'
11pvsml.text: The central post of the Auger. It climbed itself! Everything leans against it, including me. Five cowries, and it leans back.

160yrrm.raw: 'A handhold, worn into the wall by sixty years of touch until it took the shape of a finger. Two cowries. Hold it gently. It is tired.'
160yrrm.text: A handhold, worn into the wall by sixty years of touch until it took the shape of a finger. Two cowries. Hold it gently. It is tired.

0hujujd.raw: 'Goat! The climbers kept it. It still climbs walls sideways. Two cowries, plus the value of whatever it stands on.'
0hujujd.text: Goat! The climbers kept it. It still climbs walls sideways. Two cowries, plus the value of whatever it stands on.

1biwln2.raw: 'Swift, which nested at the Auger\'s peak and never landed lower. It sells for three cowries, up a ladder.'
1biwln2.text: Swift, which nested at the Auger's peak and never landed lower. It sells for three cowries, up a ladder.

12pwh7c.raw: 'The draft moving through the Auger\'s narrow whorls. It got a shell and kept pushing. Two cowries. It will push for one.'
12pwh7c.text: The draft moving through the Auger's narrow whorls. It got a shell and kept pushing. Two cowries. It will push for one.

172v0wp.raw: 'The drop beneath the top stair. It kept falling after everyone else stopped, and it falls still. Drop four cowries in and listen for them.'
172v0wp.text: The drop beneath the top stair. It kept falling after everyone else stopped, and it falls still. Drop four cowries in and listen for them.

0gias0i.raw: 'The highest point the Auger has ever reached. It points there still. Up. That way. The five cowries go this way.'
0gias0i.text: The highest point the Auger has ever reached. It points there still. Up. That way. The five cowries go this way.

1qjcd3k.raw: 'The low note the Auger hums when air passes through it. This one kept humming on my shelf all night. Three cowries. Please.'
1qjcd3k.text: The low note the Auger hums when air passes through it. This one kept humming on my shelf all night. Three cowries. Please.

1eywnqt.raw: 'The hole the star burned through the Margin! It opens wherever it is placed. Six cowries. Mine is on the floor. I can\'t find the floor.'
1eywnqt.text: The hole the star burned through the Margin! It opens wherever it is placed. Six cowries. Mine is on the floor. I can't find the floor.

0nghogs.raw: 'Moon snail. It drills a round hole in anything and enters. It drilled my cowries, the little button. Six cowries. Three, with a hole in.'
0nghogs.text: Moon snail. It drills a round hole in anything and enters. It drilled my cowries, the little button. Six cowries. Three, with a hole in.

13y7zsr.raw: 'A bird circled the beach, never landing. Only its shell fell. Seven cowries. It\'s still circling if you care.'
13y7zsr.text: A bird circled the beach, never landing. Only its shell fell. Seven cowries. It's still circling if you care.

0j12nk9.raw: 'The Nautilus\'s first chamber, pea-sized. It grew its own shell and keeps expanding. Six cowries today. Larger tomorrow.'
0j12nk9.text: The Nautilus's first chamber, pea-sized. It grew its own shell and keeps expanding. Six cowries today. Larger tomorrow.

1n1koir.raw: 'Gran\'s cast. It appeared in my bundle, resting atop the cowries. No price. I carried her. I never purchased her, and I would not sell her.'
1n1koir.text: Gran's cast. It appeared in my bundle, resting atop the cowries. No price. I carried her. I never purchased her, and I would not sell her.

1t2g6ew.raw: 'Kelp from the Low Line. It stands tall when the tide recedes. It lies down out of politeness when you sit nearby. Manners cost two cowries.'
1t2g6ew.text: Kelp from the Low Line. It stands tall when the tide recedes. It lies down out of politeness when you sit nearby. Manners cost two cowries.

1hs3s5e.raw: 'A patch of sea meadow with a face in it! Step on it, and it flattens, slowing your stride. Two cowries. Retrieve your foot before supper.'
1hs3s5e.text: A patch of sea meadow with a face in it! Step on it, and it flattens, slowing your stride. Two cowries. Retrieve your foot before supper.

1lfo71o.raw: 'From a lightless depth, with both eyes atop its head. It stares at the sky constantly. Three cowries. It refuses to look at money.'
1lfo71o.text: From a lightless depth, with both eyes atop its head. It stares at the sky constantly. Three cowries. It refuses to look at money.

0xbi4u2.raw: 'It claims to have fallen from the sky. It has repeated this story at every market for six years. Two cowries, regardless of what it says.'
0xbi4u2.text: It claims to have fallen from the sky. It has repeated this story at every market for six years. Two cowries, regardless of what it says.

04mbp8l.raw: 'One arm from a nautilus. It let go and kept reaching, yet has found nothing to hold. Three cowries. It has been reaching for my purse.'
04mbp8l.text: One arm from a nautilus. It let go and kept reaching, yet has found nothing to hold. Three cowries. It has been reaching for my purse.

0pggr17.raw: 'Plus the jet the nautilus breathes out. It breathes other things away from it, mostly my stall. Two cowries. Pay from over there.'
0pggr17.text: Plus the jet the nautilus breathes out. It breathes other things away from it, mostly my stall. Two cowries. Pay from over there.

00dypzx.raw: 'The pause between tides, trapped in a shell. Nothing near it moves. I sold one once. The buyer remains. Four cowries.'
00dypzx.text: The pause between tides, trapped in a shell. Nothing near it moves. I sold one once. The buyer remains. Four cowries.

13cp1zc.raw: 'A frozen brine finger reached the sea floor. Points down. Always correct. Hand over three cowries, mittens on.'
13cp1zc.text: A frozen brine finger reached the sea floor. Points down. Always correct. Hand over three cowries, mittens on.

0omusxn.raw: 'The night a star crossed the moon, preserved and replayed. Twice, if you watch. Four cowries for both showings.'
0omusxn.text: The night a star crossed the moon, preserved and replayed. Twice, if you watch. Four cowries for both showings.

1dk6b8a.raw: 'Stones the Nautilus folk carried to sink a room. They sink on their own now. Three cowries. Weigh it before you pay, and after.'
1dk6b8a.text: Stones the Nautilus folk carried to sink a room. They sink on their own now. Three cowries. Weigh it before you pay, and after.

0crae37.raw: 'A gate between two Nautilus rooms. It lets one side through but never specifies which. Three cowries, or the other side of three.'
0crae37.text: A gate between two Nautilus rooms. It lets one side through but never specifies which. Three cowries, or the other side of three.

127n64w.raw: 'An interior wall of the Nautilus. Seals off whatever passes, so I take the long route around it. Three cowries. Do not lead.'
127n64w.text: An interior wall of the Nautilus. Seals off whatever passes, so I take the long route around it. Three cowries. Do not lead.

1bnplfk.raw: 'Air from a sealed room, kept so long it grew a shell. It smells of the year the room was shut. Good year. Two cowries.'
1bnplfk.text: Air from a sealed room, kept so long it grew a shell. It smells of the year the room was shut. Good year. Two cowries.

08cpil4.raw: 'Salt stains forming rings where a puddle evaporated. Steals a ring from anyone standing inside. Three cowries, minus a ring.'
08cpil4.text: Salt stains forming rings where a puddle evaporated. Steals a ring from anyone standing inside. Three cowries, minus a ring.

1vlf0m3.raw: 'The hood a nautilus shuts its door with. Shuts any door. Mine hasn\'t opened since! Writing this through the window. Four cowries.'
1vlf0m3.text: The hood a nautilus shuts its door with. Shuts any door. Mine hasn't opened since! Writing this through the window. Four cowries.

17oab5x.raw: 'Gleaner\'s footprint, house-long. Stars land in it willingly. Three cowries per footprint. The foot isn\'t mine to sell.'
17oab5x.text: Gleaner's footprint, house-long. Stars land in it willingly. Three cowries per footprint. The foot isn't mine to sell.

1vp63vh.raw: 'A star that descended brightly at a spring low and refused to go out. Don\'t put it in your pocket! Four cowries, plus a new pocket.'
1vp63vh.text: A star that descended brightly at a spring low and refused to go out. Don't put it in your pocket! Four cowries, plus a new pocket.

0erxos3.raw: 'Dune grass. Its roots keep the Long Strand intact, but one root walked away, and this is it. Two cowries. The Strand wants it back.'
0erxos3.text: Dune grass. Its roots keep the Long Strand intact, but one root walked away, and this is it. Two cowries. The Strand wants it back.

1l9nnd5.raw: 'A brittle salt plant from the base of a label post. It spits, and salt accumulates on whatever it hits. Two cowries per pinch.'
